english: His work was so beautiful that it was said to bring tears to the eyes of even the most hardened cynic.
kokborok: Bini samung aswk naithok wngkha je omo haikhe sajakha haino ah jottoni slai kwrakkuk ninda khainai ni mokolo phano mwktwrwi tubui mano.

english: One day, a young woman named Amara was walking through the market when she saw the blind beggar.
kokborok: Salsa, khoroksa bwrwima sikli mung Amara ah hati twih himwi thangmani bojora bo ah mokol nukya bikha birnaino nukha.

english: She was immediately captivated by his work, and she stopped to watch him for a long time.
kokborok: Bo daktino bini samung bai kwlwkkhaa, tei bo kaisa kwdwkma jora karwi bono naina bwkhak bathakkha.

english: When he was finished, she approached him and asked if she could learn how to sculpt soil.
kokborok: Jephuru bo paikha, bo bini thani agukkha tei swngkha tumungno bo bahaikhe hachingsa takma swrwng mano.

english: The beggar smiled and told her that he would be happy to teach her.
kokborok: Ah bikha birnai mwnwikha tei bono sakah je bo bono phwrwngma bwkhak tongthoknai.

english: Amara spent the next few weeks learning from the beggar.
kokborok: Amara ah tei kisa hatibarok ah bikha birnai ni thani swrwngmani simi katikha.

english: He taught her the basics of soil sculpting, and he showed her how to create different shapes and textures.
kokborok: Bo bono ah yaphang hachingsa takmani phwrwngkham tei bo bono phunukha bahaikhe juda juda banokmarok tei taknairok swnamkha.

english: Amara was a quick learner, and she soon became very skilled at the art.
kokborok: Amara wngkha khoroksa dakti swrwngnai, tei bo daktino ah rikmung belai yaksrai wngkha.

english: One day, the beggar told Amara that it was time for her to demonstrate her skills.
kokborok: Salsa, ah bikha birnai Amara no sakhaa je amo bini yaksrairok kubui phunukma bwkhak bini bagwi jora wngkha.

english: Recycling is a vital process that helps to protect the environment and conserve natural resources.
kokborok: Teiwaisa swnamphimani kaisa mal tangraida je tongkhor no katirwui chubanarok tei habar khatima bumukrok.

english: By recycling, we can reduce the amount of waste that goes to landfills and incinerators, conserve energy, and save money.
kokborok: Teiwaisa swnamphimani bai, chwng khibijak rangmari khairiwui mano je hakorsupungmarok bwkhak thangmani tei soknanini rok, phan khatima, tei rang khatirwma.

english: The process of recycling begins with the collection of recyclable materials.
kokborok: Teiwaisa swnamphimani tongraida chengmarok wngkha teiwaisa swnamanaijat manwi-khwnwi rok thummani bai.

english: These materials are then sorted and processed into raw materials that can be used to create new products.
kokborok: Oh manwi-khwnwi rok wngkha rwngrem tei tongraidrok kwthwng manwi-khwnwi je kwtal thaihmanwirok swnamjakma bwkhak phwnangjagwi mano.

english: For example, plastic bottles can be recycled into new plastic bottles, aluminum cans can be recycled into new aluminum cans, and paper can be recycled into new paper products.
kokborok: Phunukmari karwi, plastic bottle kwtal plastic bottles o teiwaisa swnamjak mano, aluminum cans bo kwtal aluminum cans bo teiwaisa swnamjak mano, tei swilaih bo kwtal swilaih thaimanwirogo teiwaisa swnamjak mano.

english: Recycling has many benefits.
kokborok: Teiwaisa swnamjakmani kwbangma manmari rok tongo.

english: It helps to reduce the amount of waste that goes to landfills and incinerators, which can help to protect the environment and conserve natural resources.
kokborok: Omo khibijak rangmari je hakorsupungmarogo thangma bwkhak tei soknanirok khairiwui chupachu khai mano, abo habar no katirwnani tei habar khatima bumukrok.

english: Recycling also conserves energy, as it takes less energy to produce products from recycled materials than it does from raw materials.
kokborok: Tewaisa swnamphimani wngkha kaisa phan khatimani, iko omo kisa phan nao thaihmanw thaihrwma bwkhak manwi-khwnwi teiwaisa swnamjak simi hwnkhe omo kwthwng manwi-khwnwirok khaijakma simi.

english: In addition, recycling can save money, as it can reduce the need to extract and process raw materials.
kokborok: Jora rwui, teiwaisa swnamphimani rang khatiwui mano, omo je kwthwng manwi-khwnwirok sepma tei tangraida bwkhak nangmani khairiwui mano.

english: The launch of new recycling programs in most countries has ended the color-coded recycling system.
kokborok: Oh kwtal teiwaisa swnamjakmani pandarok chengsamani kwbangma haktor rogo pali-raidarok teiwaisa swnamjakmani tangdal paithago phaikha.

english: This is because the new programs are designed to accept all recyclable materials, regardless of their color.
kokborok: Omo tamni hwnkhe kaisa kwtal pandarok jotto teiwaisa swnammanai manwi-khwnwi rokno gosima bwkhak swnamjakha, bohrokni pali khauarya.

english: The new programs are also more efficient, as they use automated sorting systems to process recyclable materials.
kokborok: Oh kwtal pandarok wngkha teibo yaksrai, bohrok saknibaisak wngjak rwngremni tangdal bwkhak teiwaisa swnamjak mawnwi-khwnwi rok tangraida phwnangjago.

english: "Ms. Smith," I said, "I'm really looking forward to the food and wine festival this weekend.
kokborok: "Ms.Smith, " ang sakha, "ang kubuino ah chahthai tei arak ter rok oh hatibar bwkhak bwskango naising tongo.

english: I've heard that the tasting events are going to be amazing."
kokborok: Ang khwnamani je ah chainaimani pandarok belai mlangchamani haii wngnai hwnwi."

english: "Yes, they are," Ms. Smith replied.
kokborok: "In', bohrok bo, " Ms. Smith kokphirok kha.

english: "But be careful not to overdo it. You don't want to get too full or too tipsy!"
kokborok: "Phiya kisa naikani khaidi omo belai khaiina tathangdi. Nwng belai kuplung wngna muchungya eba belai kephek wngma bwkhak!"

english: "I won't," I said. "I'll just sample a few things from each booth."
kokborok: "Ang wngya, " ang sakha. "ang haino kisa manwirok nokakarijak thwgwi yakphunuk naiyanw."

english: "That's a good plan," Ms. Smith said. "And be sure to drink plenty of water to stay hydrated."

english: These programs can provide people with information about a variety of health topics, and they can also offer support and resources for people who are trying to make healthy changes in their lives.

kokborok: Borokrokno elem bagma bai tei yaksraini bohrok sakduk chongmanino swnamna nango, sakduk rwng bemar rokno kati thani chubai mano, sakduk hamrio, tei takduk naitwi swkrok khairwi mano.

kokborok: Chasalo, oroni hoda thai kengjak sakduk rwng rwngkok yapharo sakduk chamung kokkhak salaikokno twi.

kokborok: Rwngnokrok dalbidal borok, chakrarok khobwinai, chwrairok, tei okrarok manjakphaikha.

kokborok: Ang bisirok karwi luku laisujakma phwnangwi phayo, tei ang ah jora bising kaisa kwbangma swlaimarok nukha.

english: The rise of ride-sharing apps like Uber and Lyft has made it more convenient for people to get around without having to own a car.
kokborok: Ah kasama-bakmani apps kasamung Uber tei Lyft kahai omonno teibo borokni bagwi chasujak swnamkha yaksiyagra manma bwkhak malkhung naharya karwi.

english: However, this has also led to a decline in the use of public transportation.
kokborok: Haiphanom omo ah luku laisujaknai phwnangma bising kaisa paihma bwkhak twlang thango.

kokborok: Ani doyung bising, ah luku laisujaknai tangdal wngkha aswk belai kahamya.

kokborok: Luku laisujaknai wngkha kaisa nangkuma bokcho doyungni infrastructure, tei omo thahnglaiso kesepjak tei sitrawmani khaina bwkhak chubai mano.

english: I believe that we need to make public transportation more attractive to people by making it more reliable and affordable.

kokborok: O kamini borokrok pizza chamungni bagwi belaikheno kung chukjakbayo te bohrok kahamkhe naikolwi swnamlayo.

english: They used only the freshest ingredients, and they took their time to make sure that the pizza was cooked perfectly.
kokborok: Bohrok kwthang kwchwng mwikwthwng tei jora kolok naiui pizza no belai kaham khe swnamlayo.

kokborok: Bo khoroksa faraway thaini beraikhiri khwlainaise. bo kamini pizza kothokno twywi kok khwnajak.

kokborok: O pizza belaino kothok tei o sinijakya borok belaikhe hamjakha. bo wansukha o kamiono tongsinai hwnwi.

english: The stranger learned a lot about the village while he was there.
kokborok: O sinijakya borok kwbangma manwino twywi swrwngkha bo kamio tongphru.

english: He learned about the people's history, their culture, and their way of life.
kokborok: Bo borok rokni laibuma, hukumu mukumu tei bohrokni tong gwrwngni lam rokno swrwngkha.

english: He also learned about the importance of pizza in the village.
kokborok: O pizza bwswk joratwi nangkukmani o kamio abono twywi bo sinani mankha.

english: Pizza was more than just a food to the villagers; it was a symbol of their culture and their heritage.
kokborok: O pizza alaida chamungni slaibo borom rwjago o kamio tei o pizza bohrokni kamini hukumu mukumuni sinimung rwo.

kokborok: Oh yaar, nwng ah kwtal kubuiya siyan bagwi da khwnankha je nini muchungsama khanangjakrok borok kahai mano?

kokborok: Kubuino, omo adamlang haiyada?

kokborok: Ang kokma, omo kahaiya omo kubuino sinaiwansukma eba jesamanwi, phiya omo tabukbo naithok kolopjakma wngkha.

english: I think it could have a lot of applications in the future, like for customer service or even in the military.
kokborok: Ani wansukma omo kaisa kwbang koibwlaihrok ah thinangni bising tongwi mano, painai borok suarimung bagwi kahai eba ahaino ah kerong thong bising.

english: But you know what's really scary?
kokborok: Phiya nwng saimano kubuio tamo sikrima?

kokborok: Kubuio je sikrinairok oh tansep auaima bwkhak phwnang mano bohrokni tangbokhrwi te kwtal logisong bhorti khaima.

english: I mean, imagine if they could create videos that looked and sounded like they were made by real people, but were actually just being generated by a computer.
kokborok: Ani kokma, khachongmung tumungno bohrok videorok swnam mano je nukma tei khwnama kahai bohrok kubui borok bai swnamma tongjak, phiya kubuio kaisa computer bai haino achairwjak wngkha.

english: That would be really hard to detect, and it could be used to spread all kinds of lies and hate speech.
kokborok: Abo kubuino tikhlaina bwkhak kuthuk wngwi mano, tei amo jotto dalbidal tatalrok tei naslema kokmung auaima bwkhak phwnangjakma wngmano.

english: I'm not saying that we should ban artificial intelligence or anything, but we definitely need to be aware of the potential risks.

kokborok: Chwng wngkubui swnamna bwkhak nango je oh tansep wngkha kahamni bagwi phwnangkha, tei hamya ni bagwiya.

english: Anyway, that's just my two cents.
kokborok: Haiphano, aborok haini nai kanwi rarok se.

kokborok: Nwng sakno twywi chukjak tei khapangjak kwrak wngna nango omo ah kuchuk sogwina hwnkhe.

kokborok: Ang muitiomankha ah puila jora ang bapung saka kasamani.

kokborok: Omo talbung bising wngkha tei ah salbar wngkha kwchang tei nokbarsibsib.

kokborok: Ang jotto kisa srapsarok bathakgwwi ani hama romna nagno.

kokborok: Phiya choliwui thangkha, tei paithago ang ah bochlongo sogwikha.

kokborok: Ang uansukha ang jesaphano khai mano.

english: Dear Sonya, I hope this letter finds you well.
kokborok: Khajani Sonya, ang kha khwlayo, oh titun manphuru nwng kaham kwrwngno tongo.

kokborok: Ang nono chini nukhungni khamparni simi swiui tongo, je khamparo taklai hukbar bwthaih kaham wngkha.

english: One way to address this challenge is to build sustainable food systems.
kokborok: O kebengmungno kasunani kaisa lam wngkha kaisa chahthai tangraida kwrak swnammung.

english: Sustainable food systems are those that are able to meet the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.

english: This means that sustainable food systems must be environmentally sound, economically viable, and socially just.

english: Here on our farm, we are working to build a sustainable food system by using organic farming practices, conserving water, and reducing our carbon footprint.
kokborok: Oro chini khamparo, chwng bithi sapulyani lamno rwksaui, twi khatiui tei chini carbon yapaimarino khaikwlaiui kaisa chahthai tangraida kwrak swnamui tisanani samung tangwi tongo.

english: We are also working to connect with local consumers so that we can sell our produce directly to them.

english: I'm wondering if you could share your thoughts on the different applications of the term "depression," and how it's changed over the past few decades.

english: There are many different factors that can contribute to depression, including genetics, personality traits, life events, and medical conditions.
kokborok: Genetics, borokni gwrwng, langmani patimung tei sak halokno khobwi khabaimao logirwui mannai abohai kwbangma pher tongo.

english: As a result, there is no one-size-fits-all approach to treating depression.

english: One is that depression is often characterized by a low mood, anhedonia (loss of interest in activities), and fatigue.
kokborok: Kaisa wngkha je khabaimano moji kisa, anhedonia (tangnani muchungma kwrwi), tei lengma-baikhe yasi kaijago.

english: They should not simply be passive listeners, but should be actively thinking about what they are hearing and trying to remember it.

english: There are a number of ways to encourage conscious memory work in listening comprehension lessons.
kokborok: Aro kwbangma lama lombor tongo sijak mukumu samung khatungrimung bwkhak khwnamani sirwkmung phwrwng bwchap bisingtwi.

english: One way is to use repetition.
kokborok: Kaisa lama hwnkhe teisa samani phwnangwi mano.

english: This can be done by having students listen to the same passage multiple times, or by having them read a passage aloud multiple times.
kokborok: Omo rwngswrwngnairokno hainohai dalkwbang joratwi passage khwnarimani bwkhak khaimano, eba bohrokno kaisa passage dalkwbang joratwi sotonwi porirwi mano.

english: Repetition helps to fix the information in students' memories.
kokborok: Teisa samani rwngswrwngnairokni' kokthum bising mukumurokno thepam bwwkha chubamarok.

english: Another way to encourage conscious memory work is to have students take notes while they are listening.
kokborok: Tei kaisa sijak mukumu samung khatungrimung bwkhak lama hwnkhe rwngswrwngnai rokno samarirok khwlai naraknani jephuru bohrok khwnai tongphuru.

english: This forces them to pay attention to what they are hearing and to think about what is important.
kokborok: Omo bohrokno sakphanwi saktongma rwma bwkhak bohrok tamo khwnai tong tei omoni bagwi wansukdi je tamo nangkukma.

english: Students can also be asked to write down a summary of what they have heard.
kokborok: Rwngswrwngnairok no kaisa kokbwkrai swina bagwi swjkak mano bohrok je khwnamani.

english: This helps them to organize the information in their minds and to remember it more effectively.

english: These include asking students questions about what they have heard, having them discuss the passage with each other, and having them create their own graphic organizers to represent the information.
