english: As they walked, John looked at Mary and he knew that he wanted to spend the rest of his life with her.
kokborok: Bohrok himkheno, Johan Mary no naisikha teie bo saimankha je bo bini langmani paithago bini logi jora katina muchung jago.

english: As I'm driving down the road, I see a goat giving birth in the median.
kokborok: iko ang ah langma tola chalugwi thangkheno, ang kaisa pun nukha kwcharni bising baih rwmani.

english: She's lying on her side and her two front legs are extended in front of her.
kokborok: Bo bini babai rokowui tongkha tei bini bwskangni yethek kongnwirok bini bwskang bising phololokjak wngkha.

english: The baby goat is coming out of her right side and it's head is already visible.
kokborok: Ah pun bwsa phatar ongkhorwi tongka bini yakgra babai tei omoni khorok swkango nukjakma wngkha.

english: The mother goat looks up at me and I can see the fear in her eyes.
kokborok: Ah pumma ano saka naisikha tei ang bini mokolrokni bising kirima nugwi mano.

english: She's probably wondering if I'm going to hurt her or her baby.
kokborok: Bo uanamasingsa wngthothok wngjak tumungo ang bono eba bini bwsa no dukhu manrwn bwkhak thangwi tongo.

english: I stop the car and get out.
kokborok: Ang malkhung bathakha tei phatar ongkhorkha.

english: I walk over to the goat and kneel down next to her.
kokborok: Ang ah punni gana himwi thangkha tei bini ganao yasku tola swngkha.

english: I gently stroke her head and tell her that everything is going to be okay.
kokborok: Ang bini khorokno twrwk khai bukha tei bono sakak jottomanwi kaham wngna bwkhak thangwi tongo.

english: The baby goat starts to emerge and I can see that it's a little girl.
kokborok: Ah pun bwsa peplana bwkhak chengkha tei ang nugwi mankha je omo khoroksa bwrwi chonsa hwnwi.

english: She's crying and her mother licks her clean.
kokborok: Bo kabwi tongo tei bini buma bono swlagwi kwchwng khayo.

english: I watch as the mother goat and baby bond and I feel a sense of peace.
kokborok: Ang mwrwkha iko ah pumma tei bini bwsa kwthailaima tei ang kaisa sinai simanwi kwchangtotok wansukmung wngkha.

english: Rental cars are a convenient way to get around when visiting a new city or country.
kokborok: Malkhung solok namanirok wngkha belai kaham jephuru kwtal dholi eba hakotor kitingwi naina thang phuru.

english: They offer the flexibility to explore at your own pace and can be a more affordable option than public transportation.
kokborok: Bohrok nwng chajaktwii tei chukmani joratwi nono yapharo abo lukurok malkhung bai thang-him wngmani swlai hamkugo.

english: When renting a car, it is important to compare prices from different companies and to read the fine print of the rental agreement carefully.
kokborok: Malkhungno solok naphuru khe, dalbidal companirokni morokmung no sulwi naina nango tei solok namani gosemung bwlai no kaham khe porewi naina nango.

english: Be sure to ask about any additional fees, such as fuel charges, insurance, or tolls.
kokborok: Malkhung solok naphuru tamorok rwna nangphino abono bo swng di, thokni rang, insurance ni, eba lamarok ni.

english: It is also a good idea to take pictures of the car before you drive it away, so that you have proof of its condition in case of any damage.
kokborok: Chalokya swkang malkhungni mangpili nakhe bo hamo, tamoni hwnmale nini thani saki tongrwknai malkhung hamya wngwi thangtrwng khe.

english: If you are planning to rent a car for an extended period of time, you may be able to get a better deal by purchasing a rental car package.
kokborok: Nwng malkhungno jora phologwi solok nanani uansogwi tong khe, nwng tei bo malkhung kaham na'ui mano aboni raida no salaiwi paiwi nakha hwnkhe.

english: These packages typically include a set number of days of rental, as well as unlimited mileage and other extras.
kokborok: O raidarok wngkha malkhungno salbwswk solok nanai, tei bwswk dwgwi chaloknai tei alka jora na'ui de choloknai akorog.

english: You may also be able to get a discount if you book your rental car in advance.
kokborok: Nwng swkangkuk malkhung solok nakha hwnkhe kisa kwlai khe bo manwi mano.

english: When picking up your rental car, be sure to inspect it carefully for any damage.
kokborok: Nini solok najak malkhungno nana thangphuru, tamorok hamya wngwi tong abo kaham khe siwi nadi.

english: If you see any damage, be sure to note it on the rental agreement.
kokborok: Hamya wngjakrok nugwi tongkhe, solok namani goselaimungo kaham khe salai di.

english: You should also take pictures of the car before you drive it away.
kokborok: Nwng o malkhungno chalokya swkang mangpili tisa wi nadi.

english: "Don't judge a book by its cover" is a popular saying that means one should not make assumptions about something based on its outward appearance.
kokborok: "Bwkhap naywi simi bijap bisingni no taamjokdi" kaisa sinikukjak sahthai aboni kokmang wngkha saka-saka nukma bai simi kaisa manwi no twywi chongwi tapaidi.

english: This can be applied to people, places, and things.
kokborok: Omo borok, thairiok, tei manwirok bwkhak thepajak mano.

english: For example, you might meet someone who has a bad reputation, but after getting to know them, you realize that they are actually a kind and gentle person.
kokborok: Phunukmari karwi, nwng masaswk bai malai mano je hamya munggang tongo, phiya saimankha je bohrok kubuono khoroksa kaham tei togkaham borok wngkha.

english: Or, you might see a building that looks old and rundown, but when you go inside, you find that it is actually a beautiful and historic place.
kokborok: Eba, nwng nugwi mano kaisa dalan je kwcham tei rundown nukjago, phiya jephuru nwng bisingo thango, nwng mananw je omo kubuio kaisa naithok tei laihbuma thai.

english: There are many reasons why it is important not to judge things by their appearance.
kokborok: Aro kwbangma kokrok tongo tangwi omo kaisa nangkukma je bohrokni peplamung bai manwirok dorbaphang bwkhak takhaidi.

english: First, it can lead to making incorrect assumptions.
kokborok: Puila, omo kaisa chaya anumantwi swnamani bwkhak dagi mano.

english: Second, it can prevent us from seeing the true value of something.
kokborok: Nwirem, omo chwngno nainani simi mungsaswk ah kubui moroukma kasogra mano.

english: Third, it can create unnecessary conflict and division.
kokborok: Thamrem, omo nangnungya nanglaimung tei khakmani swnamjak mano.

english: The next time you are tempted to judge something by its appearance, take a moment to pause and reflect.
kokborok: Teiwaisa phuru nwng omoni peplamung bai mungsaswk dorbaphang bwkhak lupjakma wngkha, kisa bathakdi tei yamrok kisajora nadi.

english: Ask yourself if you are really making an informed decision, or if you are simply letting your biases cloud your judgment.
kokborok: Sakbaithangno swngdi tumungno nwng kubuono kaisa kokthum chapmani swnammani wngkha, eba tumungno nwng khakeplengwi nini baises yakarmani bai nini kokchomung chumui wngkha.

english: Remember, there is more to a person, place, or thing than meets the eye.
kokborok: Muito khlaidi, aro teibo kaisa borok, thai, eba manwi slai ah mokol malaimarok bwkhak wngkha.

english: As the global economy continues to grow, so too does the demand for cotton.
kokborok: Hayungrwgwi rangthong choyai bwkhak torma bai, aswkno khulni sanmarok teibo bangkha.

english: Furthermore, the increasing popularity of sustainable fashion is driving up demand for organic cotton.
kokborok: Kwbanghachalni, twihmabai kanchum saka chalugwi lukuni hamjakma bangmabai sanmarok tongkaham khulni bagwi.

english: This has led to a surge in investment in the cotton industry, with new plantations being established in countries such as India and China.
kokborok: Omo khulni swnamkhor o rang tongmung bai twidolma bangkha, kwtal khaimani bai haktor o songchajak mani ahai India bai china.

english: However, this growth has not been without its challenges.
kokborok: Haiphano, oh tormani bataimung karwi wngwi manya.

english: The increased demand for cotton has put a strain on water resources, and the use of pesticides and fertilizers has led to environmental pollution.
kokborok: Khulni sanma bangma bagwi twini mukno phanbai sotonma tonikha, tei pesticides tei fertilizer tongkhorno sitrarwma bwkhak twlangkha.

english: Furthermore, the low wages paid to cotton farmers in developing countries has led to concerns about labor exploitation.
kokborok: Kwbanghakchalni, hamrwrwk haktoro khul chuainairokno belai beton kom rijago haini bagwi tangnai samung khwlai roknoni bagwi wanario.

english: Despite these challenges, the cotton industry remains an important part of the global economy.
kokborok: Tophano oborok bataimung tongphano, khul swnamkhor hayungrwgwi rangthongni bagwi nangkukmani bwkhak tongo.

english: It provides jobs for millions of people and is a source of vital income for many developing countries.
kokborok: Obo chirasai borokno samung bago tei omo no yaphang mal ajinani kwbangma hamwrwk hakotor rogo.

english: Furthermore, cotton is a versatile and sustainable material that is used in a wide range of products, from clothing to home furnishings.
kokborok: Kwchanghakchalni, khul wngkha kwbang sinai tei twihmanaijat manwi-khwnwi je wngmanwi kaisa kuar rem o phwnangjago, richummani simi nok sajukjakmani.

english: As the global population continues to grow, the demand for cotton is likely to remain high.
kokborok: Hayungrwgwi choyai bohrok bangmani bwkhak toro, khulni sanmarok kuchugo tongnani wngwimano.

english: This presents both challenges and opportunities for the cotton industry.
kokborok: Omo khul swnamkhor bagwi kainwino wngtongmani bataimarok tei hamjorarok.

english: Old Mrs. Brown stood on the porch of her small cottage, watching the children play in the yard.
kokborok: Chakra Mrs. Brown bini nokbwsa ni nuka o báchajak, chwrairokno nokhla thwngmano naisigwi tongo.

english: She smiled as she saw her granddaughter, Lily, run and jump with the other children.
kokborok: Bo bini busuk bwrwino nugwi mwnwikha, Lily bo kubun chwrairokbai khaichik kha tei bahor kha.

english: Lily was a bright and cheerful child, and Mrs. Brown was proud of her.
kokborok: Lily khe kwchwng tei khasrangjak chwrai, tei Mrs. Brown bini bagwi kung chugo.

english: Mrs. Brown had been a grandmother for many years, and she had seen many changes in the world.
kokborok: Mrs. Brown bwchwi wngmani kwbangma bisi wngjak, tei bo swngcharni kwbangma slaijakmung rokno nukjak.

english: She had seen the rise and fall of empires, the birth and death of new technologies, and the coming and going of many different fashions.
kokborok: Bo kwbangma Bubagraha kasamani tei baimani nukha, kwtal tangsep achaimani tei thwimani, tei kwbangma tongdálrok phaimani tei thángmani.

english: But through it all, one thing had remained constant: the love between a grandmother and her grandchild.
kokborok: Phiyaba aborokni bising twi kaisa tongrwkmani abo khe: bwchwi bai busukni hamjakmung.

english: Mrs. Brown knew that she was not the only grandmother who felt this way.
kokborok: Mrs. Brown saimano bo simibo omohai khoroksa Bwchwi ya ahaikhe uansugwitongnai.

english: All over the world, there were grandmothers who loved their grandchildren just as much as she loved Lily.
kokborok: Bebak Swngchar gwnangwi, kwbangma bwchwirok tongo bohrokni busukrokno hamjakai bo jeswk Lilyno hamjakma haino.

english: And this love was a powerful force that could stand against anything.
kokborok: Tei abohai hamjakmung belai phan gwnang abo babakni slai phano kwrak khe bachaimano.

english: Mrs. Brown had seen the love between a grandmother and her grandchild stand against the ravages of time, the cruelty of war, and even the indifference of death.
kokborok: Mrs. Brown bo nukha Bwchwi tei busukni hamjakmung abo jora hamya o phano kwchai tongo, sitra chóba o, tei thwimani jora hamyarogo.

english: She knew that this love was a precious gift, and she was grateful for every day that she could spend with her granddaughter.
kokborok: Bo saimno hamjakmung wngkha kaisa nangkukmani hili, tei bo salbrumno hambai rwo bo bini bsusuk bai tongnani jora manmani bagwi.

english: The research institute was in a state of shock today after the death of one of its leading scientists.
kokborok: Ah rutukrwk rwngnok kaisa dadarmung tongrem wngkha tini khoroksa chakra soisikwrwng thwimungni olo.

english: Dr. Teklu was found dead in his office, apparently from a heart attack.
kokborok: Dr. Teklu bini habanok o kwthwih mankha, kaisa bwkha khwchai nukjakmani simi.

english: He had been working on a top-secret study of the effects of stress on the human body.
kokborok: Bo kaisa buchuk-nukmya porimani ah mothok sago klaimarok borokni sago samung khai tongmani.

english: The news of Dr. Teklu's death has sent shockwaves through the scientific community.
kokborok: Ah koktunmarok Dr. Teklu's thwimung ah soisikwrwng hoda twih shockwaves hokha.

english: He was a brilliant scientist and a beloved colleague.
kokborok: Bo kaisa khoroksa bomtomgwnang soisikwrwng tei khoroksa bwkhani tangsong.

english: His death is a great loss to the field of medicine.
kokborok: Bini thwimung wngma kaisa bithi ni khola bwkhak kaisa kotorkuar kwmama.

english: The institute has launched an investigation into the cause of Dr. Teklu's death.
kokborok: Oh rwngnok kaisa naiphnikmung chengjakha ah Dr.Teklu's thwimung bagwi.

english: At this time, it is unclear whether his death was related to his work on the stress study.
kokborok: Oh jora, omo sraisraiya bobo bini thwimung bini samung porima mothok saka bai halokjak wngkha.

english: However, the institute is taking the matter very seriously and is committed to ensuring that the safety of its employees is always a top priority.
kokborok: Haiphano, ah rwngnok ah manwi no belai kubui khlai nai tongkha tei swmai tangjak bwkhak khasrai khlaimani je sebukrokni katima wngkha homnino kaisa buchuk tangswkang.

english: Dr. Teklu's death is a tragic reminder of the importance of mental health.
kokborok: Dr. Teklu's thwimung wngkha kaisa khaduma muitonarwkma ah khapang sakduk nangkuma.

english: Stress is a serious problem that can have a devastating impact on our physical and emotional well-being.
kokborok: Mothok wngkha kaisa kubui kebengmung je kaisa swbaimani sekrupma chini sakno twywi tei khanangjakma kaham-wngjak.

english: In the past, there was a time when the Earth was abundant with natural resources.
kokborok: Ah wngthahng bising, aro kaisa jora tongo jephuru ah hating habar bumukrok bai rungjak tongo.

english: There were vast forests, plentiful fish in the sea, and clean air to breathe.
kokborok: Aro kotor bolongrok tongjak, ah twibom bising ah kuplung, tei kwchwng nokbar hama nasama bwkhak.

english: But over time, humans have depleted these resources to the point where they are now scarce.
kokborok: Phiya jora rwgwi, borokrok oh bumurokno bukcha khlaikha ah buchuk bwkhak boro bohrok tabuk rwkma wngkha.

english: The forests have been cut down to make way for farms and cities.
kokborok: Ah bolongrok tola raphai khibijak baikha lama swnama bwkhak khamparok tei doyungrokni bagwi.

english: The fish in the sea have been overfished.
kokborok: Ah ah twibomni bising belai ah romajakha.

english: And the air has been polluted with chemicals and gases.
kokborok: Tei ah nokbar sitrajak tongo sapulswnamjakrok tei phaprok bai.

english: As a result, the Earth is now facing a number of environmental problems, such as climate change, deforestation, and pollution.
kokborok: Omoni thaihmung, ah hating tabuk kwbangma habar kebengmung malaimani wngkha, ahaino nobartwibar slaima, bolong hokmani, tei sitrarimung khaikha.

english: If we do not take action to conserve our natural resources, they will eventually be depleted and we will face a number of serious consequences.
kokborok: Tumungno chwng chini habar bumurok khatima bwkhak samung nayakhe, borok paithago bukcha khlaikha tei chwng kwbangma uansukrak thaihmungrok bwskang ma wngnai.

english: We will have to find alternative sources of energy, we will have to deal with the effects of climate change, and we will have to find ways to clean up the pollution we have created.
kokborok: Chwng slaisong pherengni yaphang naitukna bwkhak ma khlainai, tei chwng ah nokbartwibar slaimasago kwlaima bai lenden ma khlainai.

english: The time to act is now.
kokborok: Samung khwlaina jora tabukno.

english: We must conserve our natural resources and protect the environment for future generations.
kokborok: Chwng chini habar bumurokno ma khatinai tei ah habar katirwma thinang bosongrokni bagwi.

english: Today, there are many signs that our society is obsessed with beauty and fitness.
kokborok: Tabukni ojora, naithokmung tei chukmungno twywi chini hoda kha hapsukjakni kwbangma mari nukjagwi tongo.

english: From the prevalence of plastic surgery and diet fads to the rise of social media influencers, it seems that we are constantly bombarded with messages about how we need to look and act in order to be considered beautiful.
kokborok: Plastic surgery tei diet fad uarmungni simi chengwi social media khaswlainai nukjakma jora, obohaikhe matongo je naithok hwnwi chongjakni bagwi chwng bahaikhe nukjaknani tei samung tangnani nang abonni koktun pirwi chwng thakyaui twikhreng kwlairwi tongo.

english: This obsession with beauty can have a number of negative consequences, including body image issues, eating disorders, and depression.
kokborok: Naithokmungni bagwi o kha hapsukmani kwbangma hamya wngmung wngwimano, oboni bisingo tongo sak mangni jwngjal, chahmungni bemar, tei kha baimung.

english: It is important to remember that beauty is not just about physical appearance.
kokborok: Oh kok muitu narwknani nangkugo je naithokmung sakni nukjakma simia.

english: It is also about our inner qualities, such as our kindness, intelligence, and strength.
kokborok: Obo wngkha chini bisingni hammarino, romdi chini khakamma, uansukphan tei chukphan twywi.

english: When we focus on these qualities, we are more likely to find true happiness and fulfillment.
kokborok: Chwng jephuru oh hammarirokni sakao kaichomo, aphuru chwng kwkubuini tongthokmung tei kupulwng wngjakno naitugwi mananw.

english: We should also be aware of the ways in which we are compensating for our lack of self-care.
kokborok: Chini sak-naikani biyalni bagwi chwng je lamtwi derasupungwi tongo abono twywibo chwng hoda wngnani nango.

english: For example, if we are constantly dieting or spending money on beauty products in an attempt to improve our appearance, we may be trying to cover up our insecurities.
kokborok: Phunukmarini bagwi, Tumung chwng chini nukjakmano hamrwnani chaitogwi choyaui diet khwlayo eba sajokjaknai manwirogo rang swbayo hinkhe abo chwng chini kebengmungno kholopnani chaitokmase kwlayo.

english: Instead of trying to change our appearance, we should focus on loving and accepting ourselves for who we are.
kokborok: Chini nukjakmano swlainani chaitokmani swlai, chwng jetwikhe tongo atwikheno sakno hamjakthani tei gosiui nahathani kharwna nango.

english: Taking care of our physical and mental health is essential for living a happy and fulfilling life.
kokborok: Tongthokmung tei kupulwng gwnang langmani bagwi chini sak tei khapangni naikani khwlainani nangsugo.

english: When we take care of ourselves, we are sending a message to the world that we are worthy of love and respect.
kokborok: Jephuru chwng sakno naikani khwlayo, aphuru chwng hayungno kokti pirwi tongo je chwng hamjakmung tei boromni bagwi chukjak.

english: The arrival of the yoga agencies in the small town caused quite a stir.
kokborok: Ah yoga adongrok sokpaikma bising ah chikonsa aoli pherkha kaisa lorirwma paisugwi.

english: The locals were curious about this new practice, and some were even skeptical.
kokborok: Oroni borok simuchung wngkha omo kwtal loi khlaimung bagwi, tei baksa ahaino skeptical wngkha.

english: But the yogis were determined to spread their message of peace and love.
kokborok: Phiya ah yogis bohrokni koktun kwchangtotok tei hamjakma auaima bwkhak khathonjak wngkha.

english: They held classes in the park and offered free workshops.
kokborok: Bohrok ah aolikhumbari bising remrok khaiyo phiyokjak tangkhor yapharkha.

english: They also started a community center where people could come to practice yoga and learn about meditation.
kokborok: Bohrok kaisa hoda thai chengkha boro borok hai yoga loi khlaimung tei diyaimani bagwi swrwng mano.

english: One day, a young woman named Sarah came to the community center.
kokborok: Salsa, khoroksa bwrwima sikli Sarah mungwi ah hoda thai phaikha.

english: She had been feeling stressed and overwhelmed lately, and she was hoping that yoga could help her to relax.
kokborok: Bo mothokma wansukmanai tei khasumsukma wngdrop wngkha, tei bo khajamani je yoga bono lenglama bwkhak chubai mano.

english: She took a class with one of the yogis, and she was immediately hooked.
kokborok: Bo kaisa rem nakha khoroksa yogis bai, tei bo daktino thepajak thangkha.

english: She started coming to class every day, and she soon began to feel more at peace with herself.
kokborok: Bo sal thwgwi rem bwkhak phainani chengkha, tei bo daktino teibo wansukma bwkhak binisaksak bai kwchangtotok manna chengkha.

english: Sarah's experience is just one example of how yoga can change lives.
kokborok: Sarah ni saimanjak wngkha haino kaisa phunukmari bahaikhe yoga langmarok swlai man.

english: Yoga is a powerful practice that can help people to reduce stress, improve their health, and connect with their inner selves.
kokborok: Yoga wngkha kaisa phangwnang loi khlaimung je borok motok khaina, bohrokni sakduk hamrina, tei bohrokni bisingnisaksakrok bai kwrwngma.

english: Peer pressure is a significant issue that can have a major impact on a person's life.
kokborok: Buini kok ma na mani abo belai khe no jwngjal kotor se abo baithang ni langma o kaham eba hamya wng rwo.

english: It can be defined as the influence that a group of people has on an individual to conform to their norms and values.
kokborok: Abo khoroksa baithang kaisa bodol ni tongmung chamungno chagwi gosewi nahar manibo hwnmano.

english: Peer pressure can be both positive and negative, but it is often seen as a negative force that can lead people to make poor choices.
kokborok: Bwini kokno na mani abo kaham bo tongo hamya bo tongo, phiya abo hamya phaisingo mangno nukjakugo borokrokni lama saiwi nathani o.

english: There are many different ways that peer pressure can manifest itself.
kokborok: Kwbangma dalbidal lama tongwi mano buini kok ma na mano twywi abo ahai no sijagwi thango.

english: One common form is through direct pressure, such as when a group of friends tries to convince someone to do something they do not want to do.
kokborok: Kaisa nukjakuk mani wng kha baithang khe dage jakmani, abo jephuru bodol kaisa ni dolrok kaisa samung no khwlaina muchung jakya wngkhe tei khoroksa no khwlai rwna bagwi chaitogo.

english: Another form of peer pressure is indirect pressure, which can occur when a person feels like they need to do something in order to fit in with a group.
kokborok: Tei kaisa khe bwini bisingtwi kok ma namani, abo wngkha jephuru borok khoroksa kaisa bodol bai kwtha'ui tongna bagwi kok ma namani.

english: This can be especially damaging when it comes to issues such as drug use or sexual activity.
kokborok: Drugs nana bagwi dagi jakmarok eba sak motoktwi tongna bagwi dagi jakmarok khe belai no hamya khwlayo.

english: The intensity of peer pressure can vary depending on the situation.
kokborok: Kok ma namanirok abo jora no rwgwi se wngo abo kisa eba kwbang phano wngwi mano

kokborok: Ang muitomano jora waisa, nwng kaisa hachingsa buguranok tisana bwkhak aswkno tongthokjak wngkha je nwng twiyoknani thangna phano muchungjakya.

english: You worked on that castle for hours, and when it was finally finished, it was the most amazing sandcastle I had ever seen.
kokborok: Nwng damrwirok bagwi je bugranok sakao samung khaikha, tei jephuru omo paithago paikha, omo wngkha ah jottoni swlai uanaminsa hachingsa bugrakhor ang jottojora nukha.

english: You were so proud of yourself, and I was so proud of you.
kokborok: Nwng aswkno sasksakno kharuarjak wngjakha, tei ang aswkno nini bagwi khaurjak wngkha.

english: I remember taking a picture of you standing next to your castle, and you had the biggest smile on your face.
kokborok: Ang muitomano ang nini bugrakhor ganao bachawui nini kaisa mangpili namani, tei nini mwkhango belai kotorma mwnwima tongo.

english: That was one of my favorite memories of our holidays together.
kokborok: Abo wngkha kaisa ani chajakma muituphan chini thansa lenglalmasalrok bagwi.

english: I know you're older now, and you might not like the beach as much as you used to.
kokborok: Ang saimano nwng chakrama wngkha, tei nwng ah twirwkong chajakya wngwimano agi nwng chajakm hai.

english: But I hope you'll always remember the joy you used to find in playing in the sand and swimming in the ocean.
kokborok: Phiya ani khajamung ah hachingo thwngmani tei twijlango twiyokmani nwng ah tongthok manmani abono nwng homnino muitonaraknani.

english: Those are some of the best memories of my life, and I hope they're some of yours too.
kokborok: Aborok wngkha ani langmani bagwi kisa kaham muituphan, tei ani khajamung aborok nini bagwi kisasa.

english: Dear Dr. Smith, I am writing to you today to share some exciting news about the recent medical mission to the South Pacific.
kokborok: Khajani Dr.Smith, ang nono tini swihoro babai kisa khwnathotok koktun bwkhak wngwipaidrop omotoi sakham pinnok pacific salgra no twi.

english: As you know, our team of doctors and nurses spent two weeks on board the hospital ship Mercy, providing much-needed medical care to the people of the region.
kokborok: Nwng saimano, chini saknainai thwngdol tei nurse rok hati barnwi bwlap swbai Mercy rungtor sakham nok, kwbang-nangmani thummwi amchaini borokno sakham naitwi.

english: The mission was a huge success.
kokborok: Pinnok kotormakhe khwlaimankha.

english: We saw over 1,000 patients, and we were able to provide a wide range of services, including primary care, surgery, and help with childbirth.
kokborok: Chwng 1, 000 jona rogi nukha, tei chwng kuar bwtrango sebok bagwi khlaimankha, swkang naitwi no khobwi, surgery, tei chwraibwsa bahthani chubakha.

english: We also worked closely with local health care providers to train them on how to provide better care for their own communities.
kokborok: Chwng oroni sakduk naitwi baknairokbai ganawui samung khlaikha bohrokno train khaikha bahai khe teibo kaham naitwi bagwi bohrokni nini hodani bisingtwi.

english: One of the most rewarding experiences of the mission was seeing the impact that our work had on the lives of our patients.
kokborok: Pinnok ni kuk yakpai saimanmani bising twi kaisa wngkha chini rogirokni langmao chini samungni sekrupma nukjako.

english: For example, we met a young woman who had been suffering from a severe case of malaria.
kokborok: Phunukmari rwi, chwng bwrwi sikli khoroksa bai malaikha je malariani jwngjal simi kwrak kerong kahmung manjakmani.

english: She was very sick, but after being treated by our doctors, she was able to make a full recovery.
kokborok: Bo belai lumjak, phiya saknainai rokbai sakajakma olo, bo dakti no hammwi mankha.

english: She was so grateful for our help, and she told us that she would never have been able to get the care she needed without us.
kokborok: Bo chini chubama bai hambai yapharkha, tei bo chwngno sakha je bo jesaphuru phano mohai nangmanikerong kahmung manwi mangwlakhamu chwng kwrwi hwnkhe.

english: Another patient we saw was a young boy who had been born with a cleft lip.
kokborok: Teikaisa rogi chwng nukmakhe omorkisa chwrai je cleft kwkhchwikhe achaimani.

english: Once upon a time, there were two twin sisters who were as different as night and day.
kokborok: Adi nokbaro, bukhuk khoroknwi apher tongo bohrok salbai hor phertwi no pherlayo.

english: One sister, named Mary, was very studious and ambitious.
kokborok: Khoroksa bukhuk, mung khe Mary, bo khe belai porenai tei naharmung gwnang.

english: She loved to read and learn new things, and she dreamed of one day becoming a successful scientist.
kokborok: Bo porenani tei kwtal swrwngnani hamjago, tei boni imang khe salsa chujak scientist wngnani.

english: Her twin sister, named Jane, was more outgoing and adventurous.
kokborok: Boni apher bukhuk, mung Jane, khe phataro berainani tei kwtal kwtal simung sinani.

english: She loved to play sports and explore new places, and she dreamed of one day becoming a famous athlete.
kokborok: Bo khe thwngnarok hamjago tei kwtal tongthairok beraiwi nainarog, tei boni imang khe salsa kharnai kwrwng hwnwi sinijakna muchung jago.

english: The two sisters were very close, but they often disagreed about what was important in life.
kokborok: O bukhuknwirok belaino kwthalayo, phiya janija langmano twywi khe kwthalaiwi manya.

english: Mary thought that success was all about achieving your goals, while Jane thought that success was about having fun and enjoying life.
kokborok: Mary ni uansokmung khe nini iamngno supungmani abobaise langma pungsogo hwnwi, ayang Jane ni uansok ma khe langmao tonthok chathok khe tongmani abobai se langma pungsogo hwnwi.

english: One day, the two sisters were walking home from school when they came across a strange old man.
kokborok: Salsa, bukhuk kwnwirok rwngnokni phirogwi nogo thanglai tong phuru, khoroksa chakrajak borokno laiwi thanglayo.

english: The old man was sitting on a bench, and he was wearing a long white beard and a pointy hat. "Hello," said the old man. "My name is Merlin, and I am a wizard.
kokborok: A chakrajak borok khamplai kologo achukjak, tei boni khosai kuphur khe kolok tei thopo kwplar thupjak. " Hello, " sakha a borok chakra. " Ani mung Merlin, tei ang soidomni samung kwrwngse.

english: I have been watching you two for some time, and I can see that you are both very talented."
kokborok: Ang norogno kwnwino swrapsa naisigwi naimani, norok kwnw nwino suar gwngang ang nukha.

english: "Heartbreak," sighed the poet, "is the cruelest of afflictions.
kokborok: "Bwkhakwbai, " hwnwi koklopnai hama kolok khe nakha, " abose bebak ni slai tekto rwkuknai.

english: It is a pain that pierces the soul and leaves us feeling empty and alone.
kokborok: Bwkha samani wngkha kaisa chini pholano yowi tei yakarwi chwngno bukcha khwlai kwlango tei saichung khwlayo.

english: It is a fire that burns from within, consuming us with its flames.
kokborok: Abo wngkha chini bisingni hor abo khamwi tongo, chwngno aboni horjwlai bai chao.

english: It is a storm that tears us apart, leaving us broken and scarred.
kokborok: Abo wngkha nobar kotor hai chwng sichigwi swkago, chwngno swbayo tei sikriwi kwlango.

english: But even in the midst of our heartbreak, there is hope.
kokborok: Phiya chini bwkha baimani yagulo bo, khatungmung tongkho.

english: For even as our hearts are broken, they are also made new.
kokborok: Chini bwkha bai phano, abo kwtal khe swnamjak phiro.

english: We are given the opportunity to learn from our mistakes and to grow stronger.
kokborok: Chaya khwlaima bisingtwi chwng kaham tei kwrak khe bacha phina jora rwo.

english: We are given the chance to find love again, even if it is different than the love we have lost.
kokborok: Chini puilani hamjak mani abobai solaiya phano wngwi mano phiya, hamjakmungno rutuk nani jora rwjak phio.

english: So let us not despair in our heartbreak.
kokborok: Aboni bagwi chini bwkha baimano twywi mokthai kwrwi.

english: Let us instead embrace it as a part of life.
kokborok: Abohai wngya'ui abobo chini langmani bedekno hwnwi kwbagwi nalai nai.

english: Let us learn from it and grow from it.
kokborok: Aboni bisingtwi phaidi chwng swrwnglainai tei kuchuk kalai nai.

english: And let us never give up on the hope of finding love again"
kokborok: Phaidi chwng hamjakmung no yakarya'ui khatungwi rutuklaiwano.

english: After school, I usually go home and do my homework.
kokborok: Rwngnok ulo, ang nangnungya nogo thangwi ani noknisamung khayo.

english: Then I might watch TV or play video games.
kokborok: Hwnkhe ang haino TV naima eba video games thwng mano.

english: Sometimes I go out with my friends.
kokborok: Waisa-wuisu ang ani bayapsongbai phatar thango.

english: We might go to the movies, or to a park, or just hang out at someone's house.
kokborok: Chwng tokerok naina thangmano, eba kaisa aolikhumbari bwkhak, eba haini khoroksaswk ni nogo beraina thang mano.

english: On weekends, I often sleep in late.
kokborok: Hatibarogo, ang uramuram kwdwk khe thuwo.

english: Then I might go shopping, or see a movie, or go to a museum.
kokborok: Hwnkhe ang painani thangmano, eba toke naimano, eba museum bwkhak thangmano.

english: I also like to spend time with my family.
kokborok: Ang ani nukhungni borok bai jora katina chajago.

english: We might go out to dinner, or play games, or just watch TV together.
kokborok: Chwng horchahmungni bagwi ongkhor mano, eba games thwng mano, eba haino thansakhe TV naimano.

english: I'm really enjoying my life after school.
kokborok: Ang ani langma rwngnok ni ulo kubuno tongthogo.

english: I have a lot of freedom, and I can do whatever I want.
kokborok: Ani thani kwbang phiyokjakma tongo, tei ang jesaphano muchungtwi khaimano.

english: I'm also learning a lot about myself, and about the world around me.
kokborok: Ang saksakni bagwi kwbangma swrwngwi tongo, tei ani yaksiyagra hayungni bagwi.

english: I'm excited to see what the future holds.
kokborok: Ang naina bagwi tongthokjak ah thinango tamo khatijakrok.

english: The debate about whether animals are happier in the wild or in zoos is a complex one with no easy answers.
kokborok: Malmatarok bolongo da tongthokjak eba malkhoro, obono twywi kok phiroklaimung wngkha kaisa kutuk, jeboni mungsa kwlai phirokmung kwrwi.

english: There are many factors to consider, including the individual animal's needs, the type of zoo, and the quality of care provided.
kokborok: Masa-masa malni nangma, malkhorni dal tei naikani khwlaimani hammarino khobwi kwbangma pherrok uansuknani nango.

english: Some animals, such as elephants, are highly social and need to interact with other elephants in order to thrive.
kokborok: Kisaswk mal, romdi mayungrok, belaikhe hodarwkjak tei hamkwraini bagwi kubun mayungbai kwrwngna nango.

english: In the wild, elephants live in herds of up to 100 individuals.
kokborok: Bolong amchayo, mayungrok maksarani sai kwbangni buthubo tongwi 100 tonglayo.

english: They spend their days foraging for food, playing, and socializing.
kokborok: Bohrok, bohrokni salno chahmung naitukthani, thwngthani tei hoda kwrwngthani lairwo.

english: In a zoo, elephants may not have the same opportunities to interact with other elephants, which can lead to boredom and frustration.
kokborok: Malkhor khorsao, mayungrok kubun mayungbai kwrwngnani kaisa sep kwrwi wngphano, abo selemung tei khabaimung tubuimanw.

english: Other animals, such as lions, are solitary hunters.
kokborok: Kubun malrok, romdi singhorok, saichwng muikognai.

english: In the wild, lions live in prides of up to 15 individuals.
kokborok: Bolong amchayo, singhorok makchiba joratwi buthupkhe hakhoro tongwi 15 tongo.

english: However, each lion within the pride has its own territory and does not interact with other lions very often.
kokborok: Haiphano, hakhor bisingo tongnai singhorokni janija ari tongo tei kubun singhorokbai aswk kwrwngya.

english: In a zoo, lions may be able to live in larger enclosures with more space to roam, which can provide them with more opportunities to exercise and explore.
kokborok: Malkhor khorsao, singhorok beraiui manthotok thaino khobwi kotorkhe dumjak thai tongwimanw, abo bohrokno sakloi tei naituk beraithani teibo sep kwbang rwo.

english: The type of zoo also plays a role in the welfare of its animals.
kokborok: Malkhorni dalbo aroni malmatarokni hamkwrayo samung tango.

english: Some zoos are very large and provide their animals with spacious enclosures, while others are smaller and may not have as much space.
kokborok: Kisaswk malkhor belai kotor tei aro tongnai malmatarokno dumjak kuar thaini sep rwo, kubunrok hinkhe chikon tei aswk thai kwrwiphano wngmano.

english: The type of fish you choose will depend on your personal preferences and the intended use for the fish.
kokborok: Ah ah sapokthaih nwng saimani ninni sakbaihthang hamjaksukmung sakao sakboknai tei ahni bagwi muchungjakma phwnangma.

english: If you are looking for a fish that is high in omega-3 fatty acids, then you may want to choose a wild river fish.
kokborok: Tumung nwng kaisa ah naimani wngkha omo wngkha kuchuk omega-3 bupham kwkhwirok bising, hwnkhe nwng kaisa bolong twima ah saima bwkhak muchung mnao.

english: These fish are typically lower in contaminants than farm-raised fish.
kokborok: Oh ah wngkha hainohai sitra khlaimarok tola bising tongo khampar-torrwjak ahni slai.

english: However, wild river fish can be more expensive and difficult to find.
kokborok: Haiphano, bolong twima ah teibo morokm wngmano tei 3 manna bwkhak.

english: If you are looking for a fish that is mild in flavor and easy to cook, then you may want to choose a calm lake fish.
kokborok: Tumungno nwng kaisa ah ni bagwi naimani wngkha je thokmung bising khakaham wngkha 1 songna bwkhak, hwnkhe nwng kaisa kwchang twithu ah saima bwkhak muchung mano.

english: These fish are typically not as high in omega-3 fatty acids as wild river fish, but they are still a good source of protein and other nutrients.
kokborok: Oh ah wngkha hainohai kuchukya omega-3 bupham kwkhwirok tong iko bolongni twima eba kwchang twithu ah, phiya bohrok wngkha tabukbo kaisa kaham yaphang protein tei kubun chahkohlomrok.

english: Calm lake fish are also typically more affordable and easier to find than wild river fish.
kokborok: Kwchang twithu wngkha hainohai teibo naimano tei kwlaikuk manma bwkhak bolongni twima ah slai manma bwkhak kwlaikuk.

english: If you are looking for a fish that is low in cost and easy to care for, then you may want to choose a stock pond farm raised variety.
kokborok: Tumungno nwng kaisa ah ni bagwi naimani wngkha je kom swbaima bising tei 1 naikani bwkhak, hwnkhe nwng saima bwkhhak muchung mano kaisa khatijak pukhiri khampar dalbidal torrwmani.

english: These fish are typically raised in controlled environments and are fed a diet that is designed to promote growth.
kokborok: Oh ah wngkha hainohai torrwjak wngkha habarok kasojakma bising tei omo kaisa chahmung charijak tongo je torrwma remstimung bwkhak rikjakma wngkha.

english: Stock pond farm raised fish are typically not as high in omega-3 fatty acids as wild river or calm lake fish, but they are still a good source of protein and other nutrients.
kokborok: Khatijak pukhiri khampar ah torrwkha hainohai kuchukya omega-3 bupham kwkhwirok tong iko bolongni twima eba kwchang twithu ah, phiya bohrok wngkha tabukbo kaisa kaham yaphang protein tei kubun chahkohlomrok.

english: Ultimately, the best type of fish for you will depend on your individual needs and preferences.
kokborok: Paithago, ah kahamkuk ah sapokthaih nini bagwi nwng nini saksani sakao sakbokma nangmarok tei hamjaksukmungrok.

english: Do some research to learn more about the different types of fish available and choose the one that is right for you.
kokborok: Baksa rutukrwk khlaidi teibo swrwngma bwkhka ah juda juda sapokthaihrok ah manthokma tei kaisa saima nini bagwi tamo chakukmani wngkha.

english: I was fortunate to attend a school that offered a wide range of AP courses and extracurricular activities, which gave me the opportunity to explore my interests and learn about different career paths.
kokborok: Ang kaisa rwngno saktongma bwkhak talikha kaham wngkha je kaisa kuar rem AP swrwngthairok tei yakbahra phwrwngjakmung samung-humungrok yappharjakha, obo ano sep rwkha ani olo manmungrok naitukberaima bwkhak tei juda juda samung lamarokni bagwi swrwngkha.

english: One of the most important things I learned in high school was how to think critically and solve problems.
kokborok: Kaisa ah jottoni slai nangkukma manwirok ang kuchung rwngnok bising swrwngma wngkha bahaikhe bejuama wansukmung tei kebengmungrok kokpaihma bwkhak.

english: My AP English and math classes taught me how to analyze text and data, and my science classes taught me how to design and conduct experiments.
kokborok: Ani AP English tei lekhamung rwngremrok ano phwrwngkha bahaikhe soibijap tei swijakrwnaino kokswbainai, tei ani soisimung rwngremrok ano phwrwngkha bahaikhe amjokmungrok lamphunukma tei rikma khalainai.

english: These skills have been essential in my college courses and my career as a software engineer.
kokborok: Oh yaksrairok ani rwngnokkotor swrwgthairokni bising nangnai wngkha tei ani samung kaisa software engineer wngwi.

english: Another important thing I learned in high school was how to work effectively with others.
kokborok: Teikaisa nangkuma manwi ang kuchuk rwngnokni bising swrwngkha bahaikhe kubunrok bai samung phwnangjakma bwkhak.

english: My participation in extracurricular activities such as student government and the debate team taught me how to communicate my ideas clearly and persuasively, and how to work as part of a team to achieve a common goal.
kokborok: Ang manjakmani yakbahraphwrwngjakmung samung-humungrokni bising ahaino swrwngnai haphang tei ah kokchirlaimung thwngdol ano phwrwngkha bahaikhe ani wansukmarok sraisrai tei pirlaimung kok manjulaima bwkhak, tei bahaikhe kaisa thwngdol bokcho haikhe samung khaina bwkhak kaisa chwrokni sokthai manma.

english: These skills have been invaluable in my career, where I often have to collaborate with others to solve complex problems.
kokborok: Oh yaksrairok ani samungni bising morokjakya wngkha, boro ang uramuram kubunrokbai thansa thangma bwkhak tongo kutuk kebengmungrok kokpaihma bwkhak.

english: Finally, my high school experience helped me to develop a strong work ethic and a commitment to excellence.
kokborok: Paithago, ani kuchuk rwngnok simari ano chubakha kaisa kwrak samung khalaithai kok hamkrai bwkhak tei hammung bwkhak kaisa yapharmani.

english: The challenging academic courses I took taught me the importance of hard work and perseverance, and the extracurricular activities I participated in taught me the value of teamwork and dedication.
kokborok: Ah bataimung swrwngnok swrwngthairok ang namani ano ah kwrak samung tei khakuar nangkukma phwrwngma, tei ah yakbahraphwrwngjakmung samung-humungrok ang manjakma bising ano ah tangthansa morokma tei saktharma ano phwrwngmani.

english: These qualities have helped me to succeed in college and in my career.
kokborok: Oh hammungrok ano rwngnokkotor bising khlaimanma tei ani samung bwkhak ano chubakha.

english: I am grateful for the opportunity to have attended a high school that provided me with such a strong educational foundation.
kokborok: Ang belai khakuplungkha kaisa kuchuk rwngnok saktongjak tongma bwkhak sep ni bagwi je ano haino kaisa kwrak rwng yaphang manthokmani.

english: I believe that the skills and knowledge I gained in high school have helped me to become a successful college student and a professional.
kokborok: Ang poito khaika je ah yaksrairok tei elem ang manmani kuchuk rwngnokni bising ano kaisa khlaimanmung rwngnokotor swrwngnai tei kaisa tangsamung wngna bwkhak chubakha.

english: The air was thick with the smell of sweat and freshly cut grass as the athletes lined up for the start of the 100-meter dash.
kokborok: Nokbar belai rwjak kolomtwi ni bahai bai tei kwtharkhe jabra rajak mari saka thwngnairok 100-meter dash chengani twi naisingjak.

english: The crowd was cheering wildly, eager to see who would come out on top.
kokborok: Borokkwbang rok koborkhai chiriklaijak, naina bagwi muchunglaijak sabo sakao phainai hwnwi.

english: The gun went off, and the runners sprinted out of the blocks.
kokborok: Silai kogwi rwkha, tei kharnairok kasojaknairokni ongkhorwi khaprumlaikha.

english: They were all evenly matched, and it was anyone's race.
kokborok: Aro jotto ni baksa-baksa thwngmung, tei abo jebakaisa ni batai kahachikmung.

english: As they approached the finish line, the lead changed hands several times.
kokborok: Bohrok phaithak ni mari o gana thangkha, daginai yakrok dalbidal jorarogo swlaijago.

english: In the end, it was a photo finish, but the winner was clear: a young woman with long, flowing hair and a determined expression on her face.
kokborok: Paithago, abo kaisa mangpili paimung, phiya jitinai sraisrai wngkha: khoroka bwrwima sikli kolok khai, khwnai sipsajak tei kaisa kathonjak kokmwkhang rok bini mwkhango.

english: She had won the gold medal, and she had made her country proud.
kokborok: Bo rangchak ni yakumu belep jitikha, tei bo bini hakotor no kung chukrikha.

english: As she stood on the podium, her national anthem played, and she waved to the cheering crowd.
kokborok: Bo podium saka bachaphuru, bini hodapharwk rwchapmung tamjago, tei bo borok kwbang chirikhokmani no yak pakuk phunukha.

english: She had achieved her dream, and she had shown the world that anything is possible if you work hard and never give up.
kokborok: Bo bini imangno manwi aikha, tei bo hayung no phunukha jesaphano manwi wngwi mano jodi nwng samung kwrak khaikhe tei jesakhe phano abono yakarya hwnkhe.

english: This was just one of many stories that were being written that day.
kokborok: Omo haino kaisa halok kwbangma khothoma je ah salo wngwi swijakmani.

english: All over the world, athletes were competing in their respective sports, all with the same goal in mind: to win.
kokborok: Jotto hayung sakao, thwngnairok saksakni thwngmarogo batai tonglayo, jotto kaisa khorogo along twi: kwplai wngnani.

english: Some would succeed, and some would fail, but all would have their stories to tell.
kokborok: Baksa khliamankha, tei baksa harinai, phiya jotto ni thani bohrokni kothomarok sajaknai tongo.

english: The first time I tried embroidery, I was determined to make a small, intricate design.
kokborok: Puila jorao ang embroidery khwlaina chengmani, ang aphuru chikonte khe swnamna hwnwi khachongmani, kubuljak design.

english: I chose a pattern with lots of tiny stitches, and I started working on it with great enthusiasm.
kokborok: Ang dilbidal naidal saiwi nakha kwbangma chikon chikon bwtwng bai subui, tei ang o samungno tangnani chengkha kha swrangsukma bai.

english: However, after a few hours, I realized that I was making a mistake.
kokborok: Haiphano, kisaswk dam laima ulo, ang bujui mankha angba korojak se tongkha.

english: The stitches were too small and tight, and my hand was cramping up.
kokborok: Khwtwng supmarok belai chikon tei kesepjak, tei ani yakbo saui tongbaikha.

english: Birthdays are a time to celebrate the day you were born.

english: Once you have made your list, take some time to reflect on each item and how it has made your life better.

english: Next, set some goals for the year ahead.
kokborok: Uklokni, ah bisini swkang baksa aongrok thepadi.

english: These goals can be anything you want them to be, but they should be specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound.
kokborok: Oh alongrok jesaphano bohrokno nini muchungtwi khai mano, phiya bohrok sukhurbwi, suwuimanai, khlaimanai, nangjak, tei jora-khajak wngna nangnai.

english: For example, you might set a goal to lose weight, get a promotion at work, or travel to a new place.

kokborok: Baksa kobolnairok phatarhani haphangrok bai rwjakha tangbokhrwi auaima tei kokthumya wngkha.

english: The trolls created fake accounts and used them to post pro-Trump messages and anti-Hillary Clinton messages.
kokborok: Ah trollrok kaisa tatal thikemungrok swnamkha tei phainai Trumpno-dainai koktunmarok tei Hillary Clinton-birodhi koktunamrok bwkhak bohrokno phwnangkha.

english: This myth is found in many cultures around the world, and it often features a similar story: the gods are angered by something humans have done, so they send down a plague to teach them a lesson.

english: Islam is a religion that emphasizes surrender to the will of God.
kokborok: Islam wngkha kaisa tongthar je khakrakokrok yapharma ah kaitor sakphan bwkhak.

english: This concept of surrender, or "Islam" in Arabic, is often misunderstood as meaning submission or defeat.
kokborok: Oh yapharma wansukmung, eba "Islam" Arabic bai, wngkha uramuram buchiya kokmang mothokjak eba mechenma.

kokborok: Aboni slai, bohrok mansamani wngkha je kaitor wngkha ah kaisa phangwnang je jotto manwirokno kaswkma bwkhak mano, tei je bini sakphan bwkhak yapharmani bai, bohrok wngkha kubuino phiyokjakma kubui naitukmani.

english: This concept of surrender is beautifully illustrated in the story of the Prophet Muhammad.
kokborok: Oh yapharma wansukmung wngkha naithokma kok swbaikhrubwi sama bising ah Prophet Muhammad ni kothoma.

english: When Muhammad was first called to be a prophet, he was very afraid.
kokborok: Jephuru Muhammad puila khoroksa prophet hwnwi ringjago, bo belai kirijak wngkha.

english: He didn't want to be responsible for spreading God's message.
kokborok: Bo kaitorni koktun auaimani bagwi bokjak mucwngjakya.

english: However, after much prayer and reflection, Muhammad eventually surrendered to God's will.
kokborok: Haiphano, olo kwbang surimarok tei kiphilmani, Muhammad paithago kaitorni sakphan bwkhak yaphakha.

english: He realized that it was not his own strength that would allow him to succeed, but the strength of God.
kokborok: Bo saimankhak je omobini sakni phanya je bono khlaimanmung bwkhak rwya, phiya kaitorni phan se.

english: Muhammad's story is a reminder that surrender is not about giving up.
kokborok: Muhammad's kothoma wngkha kaisa muito narwkma je yapharma wngkha yakarmani bagwi simiya.

english: Vigilante justice is a term used to describe the act of taking the law into one's own hands, typically by meting out punishment to those who have been deemed to have committed crimes.
kokborok: Sijak mankubui wngkha kaisa jora ah raida wngkha kaisani sakni yago namani samung namani swbaikhrup sama bwkhak phwnangjakha, aborokno hainohai satokmung phataro rwmani bwkhak je tanghamya khlaijak tongma bwkhak gosijak tongkha.

english: While vigilante justice may seem like a quick and easy way to get justice, it can often lead to more problems than it solves.
kokborok: Jephuru sijak mankubui mankubui manna bwkhak 1 lama tei kaisa dojak mohai khakama wngwi mano, omo uramuram teibo kebengmungrok bwkhak dagi mano omo kokpaihmani slai.

english: One of the biggest problems with vigilante justice is that it is typically not done in a fair and impartial manner.
kokborok: Kaisa ha kotorma kebengmungrok sijak mankubui uyngkha je omo hainohai kaisa banik tei keboni baiya tomung bising khlaijakya.

english: Vigilantes are often motivated by anger and emotion, which can lead them to make rash decisions and take actions that are not in the best interests of everyone involved.
kokborok: Sijakrok uramuram babai tubujak thamsi tei khanangjak bai tongo, bomo bohrokno wansukya chongmarok swnamma bwkhak dagi mano tei samungrok nama je ah kahamkuk ol manmungrok jotto kubulma bising wngya wngo.

english: Additionally, vigilantes often lack the training and experience necessary to properly handle criminals.
kokborok: Jora rwmani, sijak uramuram ah swrwngmani tei nangmani saimanjak kwrwi wngo hamya tangnai tokno kaham khai samlukma bwkhak.

english: This can lead to situations where innocent people are harmed or even killed.
kokborok: Omo tonghalokrok bwkhak dagi mano boro chayakwrwi borok hamya eba ahaino bwtharjak tongo.

english: Another problem with vigilante justice is that it can quickly spiral out of control.
kokborok: Tei kaisa kebengmung bai sijak mankubui wngkha je omo daktino mwthakmung phataro kundli wngwi mano.

english: When one person takes the law into their own hands, it sends a message to others that they can do the same.
kokborok: Jephuru khoroksa borok raidano sakni yago nakha, omo kaisa kubunrokno koktun howu je bohrok bo mohai khlaimano.

english: This can lead to a cycle of violence and retribution that can be difficult to stop.
kokborok: Omo kiasa bulaimung kiting tei sumung je mwthakma bwkhak 3 wngmanma bwkhak dagi mano.

english: In the long run, vigilante justice is rarely effective in deterring crime.
kokborok: Ah kolok jora, sijak mankubui wngkha waisa-wuisu wngjak bising tanghamya kosomani.

english: In fact, it can often have the opposite effect, making criminals more likely to commit crimes in the future.
kokborok: Kubuio, omo uramuram ah philmasago kwlaima, hamya tangnairokno swnamani teibo ahaino tanghamyarok khlaina bwkhak ah thinang bising.

english: Poetry is a universal language that transcends time and place.
kokborok: Koklop wngkha kaisa kok hayungkhobwi je jora tei thai laihmarok.

english: It can be used to express emotions, tell stories, and explore complex ideas.
kokborok: Omo khanangmarok sraisrai khai sama bwkhak phwnangjagwi mano, kothomarok sanani, tei kutuk khachongmarok kwtai karinani.

english: As a translator, I have the privilege of helping to bring poetry to new audiences by rendering it in another language.
kokborok: Khoroksa translator wngwi, ani thani ah yakarmung tongo chubanani bwkhak koklop no tubunani kwtal nainairokno kubun kok bisingtwi omo kokslaimani bai.

english: This is a challenging but rewarding task, as I must not only convey the literal meaning of the poem, but also its beauty and power.
kokborok: Omo wngkha kaisa bataimani phiya manmari samung, ang haino ah swijak koklop kokmangno yaktwina simiya, phiya omoni phan tei naithokmano bo.

english: One of the most important things to consider when translating poetry is the rhythm and meter.
kokborok: Kaisa belai nangkukma manwirok bwkhak gosima jephuru koklop translating khaiphuru ah koktheka tei suma manwi.

english: These elements are essential to the poem's overall effect, and they can be difficult to reproduce in another language.
kokborok: Oh bokhrwirok ah kokloprok bwkhak nangnai jottokhobwi wngmung wngkha, tei bohrok kubun kok bising 3 bwkhak swnamphima wngmano.

english: In some cases, I may need to adjust the rhythm or meter slightly in order to make the poem flow more naturally in the target language.
kokborok: Baksa tonghalokrok bising, ang manma nangwi mano ah koktheka mano ah kokthekano khapirwnani eba suma manwi kisisa khai koklopno bo kekhok teibo tongkaham bisingtwi kaichomwi kok tiyar khai swnamna bwkhak.

english: However, I always take care to preserve the poem's original meaning and intent.
kokborok: Haiphano, ang homnino naikini khai koklopno khatina bwkhak bini kubui kokmang tei khatharjak.

english: Another important consideration is the use of figurative language.
kokborok: Teikaisa nangkukma gosijakmani hwnkhe ah naithokjrwjak kok.

english: Poets often use metaphors, similes, and other figures of speech to create vivid imagery and add depth to their work.
kokborok: Koklopnai ahaino rwbaikok, mwnwimarok, tei kubun kokthaih lekhathaih sraisrai uansukjak swnamna bwkhak tei bohrokni samungno kuthuk jora rwma bwkhak.

english: When translating these devices, I must find equivalents in the target language that will have the same impact on the reader.
kokborok: Jephuru oh manwirokno translating khayo, ang hainohai ah kaichummung kok bisingtwi ma naituknai je ah porinai rokni sakao amtwi skerupma tongnai.

english: He especially loved the dinosaur exhibit, and he could have spent hours just looking at the skeletons and fossils.

english: "Yes, I am," the man said. "I've been studying dinosaurs for many years."

english: The world is awash in plastic.
kokborok: Ah hayung plastic bising suklaijak.

english: Everywhere you look, there it is: floating in the ocean, washing up on beaches, choking sea turtles and other marine life.
kokborok: Jottothayo nwng naisikkhe, aro omo wngkha: ah twijlang bising kochokmani, rukungrok sakao suklaijakmani, twibom kathuwarokno totra sepmani tei kubun twibomni langma.

english: Plastic pollution is a major threat to the health of our oceans, and it's only getting worse.
kokborok: Plastic sitrarwma wngkha kaisa kotor sikrimung chini twijlangrok sakduma bwkhak, tei omo ahaino hayasuk wngwi tongkha.

english: Every year, millions of tons of plastic end up in our oceans.
kokborok: Bisi thwgwi, chini twijlangrokni bisisng chirasairok tons plastic pai thango.

english: Most of it comes from land-based sources, such as rivers and streams.
kokborok: Jotto ha-khobjak yaphangrokni simi omo phaimarok, ahaino twimarok tei twidarrok.

english: Once in the ocean, plastic can take hundreds of years to break down.
kokborok: Waisa ah twijlang bising, plastic baikhrubanani bwkhak bisi rarok nai mano.

english: It can also be ingested by marine animals, which can cause them to become sick or even die.
kokborok: Omo twibom malmatarok bai khaijak mano, obo bohrokno kulum wngnani eba haino thwima bwkhak pher mano.

english: In addition to the direct harm it causes to marine life, plastic pollution can also have a negative impact on the food chain.
kokborok: Jora rwmani omo phermarok twibom langma bwkhak sakphang chaya khaimano, plastic sitrarwma ah chathaih sorduk sakao kaisa sekrupma wngya tongwi mano.

english: Plastic can accumulate in the stomachs of fish and other marine animals, and when these animals are eaten by humans, we can end up ingesting plastic ourselves.
kokborok: Plastic ah bohokrok tei kubun twibom malmatarok bising thumjak mano, tei oh malmatarok bohrokrok bai chajago, chwng chinisago plastic monogwi paijak mano.

english: The health effects of consuming plastic are not yet fully understood, but there is concern that it could lead to a variety of problems, including cancer, reproductive issues, and developmental disorders.
kokborok: Ah sakdukma sago kwlaima plastic chamani wngkha tabukbo kaham khe buchimanya khu, phiya aro wngkha uanama je bo kaisa dalbidal kebengrok bwkha dagi twlang mano, cancer khobwinai, erma lam kebgengmarok, tei hamkraijak oroiproirok.

english: Global warming is also having a significant impact on the oceans.
kokborok: Hayung tungmung wngwi tongmani bo kaisa nangkukjak sekrupma ah twijlangrok sakao.

english: Labour Day is a day to honour the contributions and achievements of workers.
kokborok: Tangmari sal wngkha kaisa sal ah khangjakmarok tei samung khlainairokni manmarokno borom rwma bwkhak.

english: It is a time to reflect on the importance of hard work and dedication, and to appreciate the intelligence and skill of those who have made our country great.
kokborok: Omo wngkha kaisa jora kiphilphima ah samung kuthuk tei saktharjak nangkuma sakao, tei ah siyankwrwng chajakma bwkhak tei aborokni yaksrai je chini hakotorno kotor kuar khai swnam tongo.

english: One such example is the story of Henry Ford.
kokborok: Kaisa ahaino phunukmari wngkha Henry Ford ni kothoma.

english: Ford was a brilliant engineer and businessman who revolutionized the automobile industry.
kokborok: Ford wngkha kaisa bomtomgwnang engineer tei bepari borok je ah automibile swnammungno pekhrupjak khayo.

english: He is credited with inventing the assembly line, which made it possible to produce cars more efficiently and cheaply.
kokborok: Bo ah aseembly ari swnammani bai borom rwjakha, bomo malkhungrok thaimung bai teibo efficiently tei kwlaima bwkhak omo wngma swnammo.

english: This led to a boom in the auto industry and helped to create millions of jobs.
kokborok: Omo ah auto swnammung bising kaisa swk bangma bwkhak twlango tei chirasai samungrok swnamma bwkhak chubakha.

english: Ford was also a strong advocate for workers' rights.
kokborok: Ford bo wngkha khoroksa kwrak sualphang samung khlairokni raidarokni bagwi.

english: He believed that all workers should be paid a fair wage and have safe working conditions.
kokborok: Bo poito khaikha je jotto samung khainairokno kaisa banik beton rwjakna nango tei kaitijak samung khlaimani tonghalorok tongo.

english: He also established a profit-sharing plan for his employees, which made them shareholders in the company.
kokborok: Bo kaisa manmari-bakmani chapmung bo songchakha bini sebukrokni bagwi, bomo borokno ah companyni bising shareholders swnamkha.

english: Ford's intelligence and dedication helped to create a better world for workers.
kokborok: Ford ni siyankwrwng tei saktharma kaisa kahamma hayung samung khlainairokni baagwi swnamma bwkha chubakha.

english: He is an inspiration to us all, and his legacy continues to inspire workers today.
kokborok: Bo wngkha kaisa khasrangrwnai chini jotto bwkak, tei bini swikwlangmung choyawui tinibo samung khlainairokno khasrangrima bwkhak tongo.
