english: A newspaper is a periodical publication containing current news, informative articles, diverse features, advertising, and other content.
kokborok: Kaisa koktunmalaih wngkha kaisa jora bojkma sapukmani tabukni koktunmarok sitokmani, kokthum koksoprok, solya mwkhangrok, primani, tei kubun tongbwlaih.

english: It is typically printed on relatively inexpensive, low-grade paper called newsprint.
kokborok: Omo wngkha hainohai sapokjak morokjakya halokma sakao, tola-theka laih koktunma sapokmarok ringjakha.

english: Most newspapers are published daily or weekly, but some may be published less frequently.
kokborok: Jottoni slai koktunmalaihrok wngkha sala karyai eba hatibaryai sapokjakma wngkha, phiya baksa kisa bar-bar sapokjama mano.

english: Newspapers are distributed through a variety of channels, including print, online, and mobile.
kokborok: Koktunmalaihrok wngkha kaisa dalbidal twilamrok twih bakjakha, sapokma khobmani, online, tei mobile.

english: Newspapers have been around for centuries, and they have played an important role in informing the public about current events.
kokborok: Kotunmalaihrok bisirarok bagwi yaksiyagra tongwi tongo, tei bohrok kaisa nangkukma samung thwngkha ah lukukno tabukni wngmarok bagwi kothumnani bising.

english: In the early days of newspapers, they were often the only source of information for people living in rural areas.
kokborok: Ah swkang salrok koktunlaihrokni bising, bohrok aswkno uramuram bohrok kami kholarok tongmani bagwi yaphang kokthum wngkha.

english: Today, newspapers continue to be a valuable source of information, but they face competition from other media outlets, such as television, radio, and the internet.
kokborok: Tini, koktunmalaihrok choyai kaisa nangmanwi kothum yaphang wngma bwkhak, phiya bohrok bataimani malayo kubun pinlam phatarlam simi, ahaino nukauai, nobarauai, tei ah internet.

english: There are many different types of newspapers, each with its own target audience.
kokborok: Aro wngkha kwbangma juda juda koktunlaihrok sapokthaihrok, omoni sakni nainai kaichommung bai thwgwi.

english: Some newspapers are general-interest publications, while others focus on specific topics, such as business, sports, or entertainment.
kokborok: Baksa koktunmalaihrok wngkha jotto-sakhamkrai sapokjakmarok, jephuru kubunrok mahmlai kokkhak salaikrok sakao naisikma, ahaino beparirok, thwngmungrok, eba tongthokmung.

english: Newspapers can also be classified by their political leanings, with some being considered liberal or left-wing, while others are considered conservative or right-wing.
kokborok: Koktunmalaihrok bohrokni thwngrwngrwk kongmanirok bai rem bakjak bo wngwi mano, baksa keboni babaiya eba bampanthi uansukukma wngjak, jephuru kubunrok khatijakma eba yagra-bwkrang.

english: In addition to providing news and information, newspapers also play an important role in shaping public opinion.
kokborok: Jora rwmani bising koktunmarok tei kokthum manthokmani bwkhak kotunmalaihrok wngkha kaisa nangkukma samung thwngo luku khachongma swnammani bising.

english: Horse racing is a popular sport that has been around for centuries.
kokborok: Korai khachik bataimung belai luku hamjajak thwngmung je bisira rwgwi yaksiyagra tongo.

english: It is a competition between two or more horses that are ridden by jockeys.
kokborok: Omo kaisa bataimung kainwi eba teibo korai rokni bisingtwi je korai batainai rokbai kasajakmani.

english: The goal is to be the first horse to cross the finish line.
kokborok: Oh along hwnkhe puila korai rokno paithakni ari laihnani.

english: Horse racing is held at tracks all over the world, and there are many different types of races, including sprints, middle distances, and endurance races.
kokborok: Korai khachik bataimung jotto hayung sakao yaprimario khaijago, tei aro kwbangma juda juda sapokthaih khachik bataimungrok, sprinys khobwi, kwchar chalmungrok, tei soijjak khachik bataimung rok.

english: The most famous horse race in the world is the Kentucky Derby, which is held every year at Churchill Downs in Louisville, Kentucky.
kokborok: Jottoni slai sinikukjak korai khachik baitaimung oh hayungni wngkha Kentucky Derby, je bisi thwgwi Churchill Downs o khaijago Louisville, Kentaucky o.

english: Horse racing is a multi-billion dollar industry, and it is estimated that over $100 billion is wagered on horse races each year.
kokborok: Kora kachik bataiimung wngkha kaisa kwbang-rarwjag dollar swnamung, tei omoni lekhama je kaisa bisi korai kachik bataimung wngkha jit karimani $100 rarwjag sakao.

english: The sport is also a major source of employment, and it supports jobs in the horse breeding, training, and racing industries.
kokborok: Oh thwngmung bo kaisa nangmani samung bumuk, te obo samungrokno dayo korai bahmani, swrwngman, tei khachik bataimung ni swnammungrok.

english: Despite its popularity, horse racing has been criticized for its treatment of animals.
kokborok: Tophano lukuhamjakmani bising omo tongphano, korai kachik bataimungrok malamatarokno saknaimung kokchirjagwi tongo.

english: Critics argue that horses are forced to race at speeds that are dangerous for them, and that they are often mistreated by their trainers and jockeys.
kokborok: Sanairok koktanlaima o je korairokno phanthonwi kachik bataimung dorimarok wngkha je abo bohrokni bagwi akochojak, tei bohrok haino borokni phwrwngnai tei korai batainairok bai kaham khe saknaijkaya.

english: In recent years, there have been a number of efforts to make horse racing more humane, including the introduction of new rules and regulations.
kokborok: Thangnai bisi romwi, aro kwbangma chaitokjagwi tongo korai kachik bataimungno teibo khairokma swnamna bagwi, kwtal raidarok tei kerem khamungrok chengmung khobwinai.

english: Despite the controversy, horse racing remains a popular sport around the world.
kokborok: Tophano kokbanglaimung tongphano, korai kachik bataimung kaisa lukuhamjakjak hayung rwgwi tongwi tongo.

english: "title": "The Importance of Sleep", "text": "Sleep is a vital part of our lives.
kokborok: "mungborom": "thumani nangkukmani", "swrwng": "thumani chini langmarokni kaisa mal bokcho.

english: It allows our bodies to rest and repair themselves, and it helps us to function properly both physically and mentally.
kokborok: Omo chini sakrokno lenglama tei bohroksaksak snaphima no gosirio, tei omo chwngno kaham khe tangmung kainwi sakni kokno tei khapangni chubachu khayo.

english: When we don't get enough sleep, we can experience a range of negative effects, including fatigue, irritability, difficulty concentrating, and impaired decision-making.
kokborok: Chwng jephuru aswk thunnani jora manya, chwng kaisa wngya sago kwlaimarok bwtrang saimanjak wngwi mano, hoihoi no khobwinai, jolirakni, 3y bwkharwmani, tei belrwjak chapmung-swnamani.

english: In the long term, chronic sleep deprivation can increase our risk of developing health problems such as obesity, heart disease, and diabetes.
kokborok: Kolok chongjakjora, dwkbemar thumani seplemarok chini sakduk hamkrai khapharmung biyalrok bangriwui mano, ahaino kuphung, bwkhani bemar, tei swtwibemar rok.

english: There are a number of factors that can affect our sleep, including our age, our lifestyle, and our environment.
kokborok: Aro kwbangma lombor bwchwlwirok tongo je chini thumani nangrwui mano, chini omor no khobwinai, chini tongdallangma, tei chini habar.

english: As we age, our sleep patterns tend to change.
kokborok: Chini omor wngkhe, chini thumani naidalrok bo naitwima bwkhak swlaijago.

english: For example, older adults may need less sleep than younger adults, and they may find it more difficult to fall asleep and stay asleep.
kokborok: Phunukmari phunugwi, okra siklarok kisa lem thuna nango chwrai siklarokni slai, tei bohrok teibo 3 bwkhak kwlai thujak tei thujak tongwi naituk mano.

english: Our lifestyle choices can also have a big impact on our sleep.
kokborok: Chini tongdal langma rok muchungmarok chini thumani o kaisa kotor sekrupma manwi mano.

english: For example, people who work long hours or who have irregular sleep schedules are more likely to experience sleep problems.
kokborok: Phunukmari phunugwi, borok je kolok damrwi samung khayo eba je thumani raidatwiya mungremrok wngkha teibo thumani biyalwi saimanjak bwkhkak wngwi mano.

english: And finally, our environment can also affect our sleep.
kokborok: Tei paithago, chini habar chini thumani manthai wngwi mano.

english: Things like noise, light, and temperature can all make it difficult to get a good night's sleep.
kokborok: Manwirok khorang, pohor, tei tungmari jotto swnam mano obo 3 bwkhak kaisa hor kaham thumani manwi mano.

english: One day, a farmer was walking through his field when he saw a dark cloud approaching.
kokborok: Salsa, chuainai bini kheto kwchartwi himwi tongphuru bo chumui kosom agukphaimani nukha.

english: He knew that a storm was coming, so he ran to his barn to get his animals to safety.
kokborok: Bo saimano je bankundri phaitongmani, haini bagwi bo goinogo khaprumwi thangkha bini malamata rokno katirinani hwnwi.

english: He gathered up his cows, pigs, and chickens and brought them inside.
kokborok: Bo musukrok, wakrok, tei tokrok kwrwngsa thayo thumkha tei bohrokno bisingo thubukha.

english: As the storm raged, the farmer watched from the window as the wind and rain whipped through the trees.
kokborok: Bankundri jolijagwi phaikha, chuainai tailamni simi naichumkha nokbar tei watwi whipped khai gerebkha buphangno.

english: He was worried about his crops, but he knew that there was nothing he could do.
kokborok: Bo bini bwthai maithaini bagwi wanajak, phiya bo saimano je aro bo mungsaphano khaimanya hwnwi.

english: The next morning, the sun came out and the storm was over.
kokborok: Teini phungno, sal pasai phaikha tei bankundri pai thangkha.

english: The farmer went outside to survey the damage.
kokborok: Chuainai phataro thangwi guriwui naikha piyakmung rokno.

english: His crops were ruined, but he saw something else that made him smile.
kokborok: Bini maithai bwwthairok baikhrupkha, phiya bo bokcho karwi nukha je bono mwnwi rwkha.

english: In the middle of the field, there was a beautiful rainbow.
kokborok: Ketho kwcharo aro naithotok chokleng keleng nukjakha.

english: The farmer knew that the rainbow was a sign of hope.
kokborok: Chuainai saiamano je chokleng keleng wngkha kaisa khajamung ni mari.

english: It reminded him that even though there are storms in life, there is always a silver lining.
kokborok: Obo bono muito khairikha je aro jodi langmao bankundri tongphano, aro homnino silver lining tongo.

english: Dramas are a genre of storytelling that typically focuses on conflict and emotion.
kokborok: Thungnuk wngkha kothoma sanani kaisa dal, jebo ualaimung tei khanangmano kitingjak.

english: They can be found in all forms of media, from film and television to theatre and literature.
kokborok: Oborokno toke tei nukauaini simi chengwi mwsakhola tei kokrwbai jora jotto dalni auailamo manwimanw.

english: While there is no one definitive definition of what makes a drama, there are some common elements that are often found in these stories.
kokborok: Kaisa thungnuk bwtwikhe wng oboni mungsa sraisrai kok swbai samung kwrwiphano kisaswk manuirok tongo jebo uram-uramno a kothomarogo manwi tongo.

english: One of the defining features of dramas is their focus on conflict.
kokborok: Thungnukno twywi kok swbai sanai gwrwngrokni bisingo kaisa wngkha ualaimani sakao bohrokni kitingwi tongma.

english: This can be internal conflict, such as a character struggling with their own emotions or beliefs, or external conflict, such as a character struggling against another person or force.
kokborok: Obo bisingni ualaimung wngwimanw, romdi kaisa tomung bohrokni sakni khanangma eba poitobai kaphraui tongo, eba phatarni ualaimung, romdi kaisa tomung kubun borok eba phan-no kebengwi kaphraui tongo.

english: Conflict is what drives the story forward and keeps the audience engaged.
kokborok: Ualaimungno kothomano swkangwi twlango tei nainairokno kulpayakhe tonio.

english: Another important element of dramas is their focus on emotion.
kokborok: Thungnukni taikaisa nangkukmani manui wngkha khanangmano twywi bohrokni kitingwi tongma.

english: Dramas often explore the full range of human emotions, from joy and love to anger and sadness.
kokborok: Thungnukrok uram-uramno borokrokni khanangmani bebak dal, tongthokma tei hamjakmani simi jolima tei dukhu jora naituk berayo.

english: This can be a powerful way to connect with audiences and make them feel something about the characters and their stories.
kokborok: Obo khwnanai-rokbai manjumungni tei bohrokni tongmung tei kothomano twywi kisaswk khao nangrwnani kaisa phankwrak lam wngwimanw.

english: Dramas can be both entertaining and thought-provoking.
kokborok: Thungnukrok tongthokmung gwnang tei unsukmumg peplarwnai kainwino wngwimanw.

english: They can offer a glimpse into the human condition and explore the complex issues that we all face.
kokborok: Bohrok borokrokni tonghalokno philiksa kaisakhe nukjak rwuimanw tei chwng je jwnglal kutukrogo kwlayo abono naituk berayo.

english: While these advances have the potential to improve our lives in many ways, they also raise important concerns about privacy, security, and freedom of expression.
kokborok: Tabukni tangsep chini langmano dal bidal lamtwi hamrwo, tei babaisa obobo wanarwo sak hui, sak kati tei kok sana manthai khochor rwrwgo.

english: For example, the use of facial recognition technology has become increasingly common in recent years.
kokborok: Romdi, mwkhang sinimung tangsep tabukni jorao thwngjakmani bangrwrwgo.

english: This technology can be used to track people's movements, identify individuals, and even predict their behavior.
kokborok: O tangsepbai borok rokni thang laisu tei tongmung chamung rokno naichomwi mano.

english: While facial recognition technology can be used for legitimate purposes, such as preventing crime and catching criminals, it also has the potential to be used for more nefarious purposes, such as surveillance and discrimination.
kokborok: Phiya mwkhang sinimari tangsepni bisingtwi raida chaya samung tangnai rokno rom nani sep bo kwlaisa wngo, abono karwi sitra samung tangnai, satok pitok khwlainai rokno bo naichomna bagwi samungo thepajago.

english: Another concern is the increasing use of artificial intelligence (AI).
kokborok: Tei dalsa wanamung hwnkhe artificial intelligence (AI).

english: AI is a powerful tool that can be used to automate tasks, solve complex problems, and create new products and services.
kokborok: AI belaikheno phan gwnang saksak samung khwlai mannai, kutuk jwngjal rokno kwlaisakhe bailchap khwlai mano tei kwtal kwtal manwi swnamwi bini sep rokbo rwwi mano.

english: However, AI can also be used to create autonomous systems that are capable of making decisions without human intervention.
kokborok: Haiphano, AI no saksak tangchap khwlai mannaikhe swnamnani bo chaitogwi tangjago aro borok rokni mungsa yak nangyaui samung khwlai manna twi.

english: This raises the risk of bias and error, as well as the potential for these systems to be used for malicious purposes.
kokborok: Obobai chaya samung tei khak baiching wngnani mari bo phaimano dal bidal samungo.

english: Finally, the development of new technologies, such as 5G networks and the Internet of Things, has the potential to create new vulnerabilities in our digital infrastructure.
kokborok: Paithago, kwtal kwtal tangsepni yak nangmabai, romdi 5G network tei Internet bai manwi khwnwi thepajakma rokbai samung chaya bangnani roknibo kiri koro wngo.

english: These vulnerabilities could be exploited by hackers and other malicious actors to steal data, disrupt services, and even cause physical damage.
kokborok: O kebelmung hackers eba juda samung sitra tangnai sinimarimung khogwi derarwi mano tei baithang dukhubo manwi mano.

english: In light of these concerns, it is important to take steps to protect our privacy, security, and freedom of expression in the age of surveillance and technological innovation.
kokborok: O wanamung rokno twywi, chwng chapthai kwlayo, sakni manthai, sak huithai tei naichom jakmarokni yakni yokna bagwi yak tolna nangnai.

english: Once upon a time, there was a young woman named Nandita who was born into a low caste.
kokborok: Kaisa jora ni kok, aro khoroksa bwrwima sikli tong mung Nandita je kaisa khil tola bisingo achaikha.

english: She was treated poorly by her family and the other villagers, and she was not allowed to go to school or learn any skills.
kokborok: Bo bini nukhungni borok bai hamyakhe saknangjakya wngkha tei ah kubun kamini borokrokbai bo, tei bo rwngnok eba jesa yaksrairok swrwngma bwkhak thangna bwkhak gosijakya.

english: One day, Nandita was walking through the forest when she came across a group of travelers.
kokborok: Salsa, Nandita ah bolongo bisingtwih himwi tongmani jephuru bo kaisa buthup berainarok malai phaikha.

english: The travelers were from a different caste, and they were kind and welcoming to Nandita.
kokborok: Ah berainairok kaisa juda juda khilni simi wngkha, tei bohrok kaham tei Nanditano lamsokmani wngkha.

english: They taught her how to read and write, and they helped her to find a job in the city.
kokborok: Bohrok bono bahaikhe porini tei swina phwrwngkha, tei bohrok bono ah doyungni bising kaisa samung naitukna bwkhak chubakha.

english: Nandita was grateful to the travelers for helping her, and she vowed to use her new skills to help others.
kokborok: Nandita ah berainairokni bwkhak hamsuthai wngkha bono chubamani bagwi, tei bo swmai tangkha bini kwtal yaksrairok kubunrok chubama bwkhak phwnangnai.

english: She started a school for children from low castes, and she taught them about their rights and how to fight for equality.
kokborok: Bo tola khilrok simi chwrairokni bagwi kaisa rwngnok swrwngkha, tei bo bohrokno phwrwngkha bohrokni raidarokni bagwi tei thansani bagwi bahaikhe bulainai.

english: Nandita's work made a difference in the lives of many people, and she helped to change the way that people thought about the caste system.
kokborok: Nanditani samung kaisa pherlaimung swnamkha ah kwbangma borok langmarokni bising, tei bo ah lama slaina bwkhak chubakha je borokni wansukma ah khil lamni bagwi.

english: One day, Nandita was walking through the village when she saw a group of young boys harassing a girl from a low caste.
kokborok: Salsa, Nandita jephuru aj kamini bisingtwih himwi tongmani bo kaisa omorkisa chwrairokno khoroksa bwrwi kaisa tola khil simi cheklekmani nukha.

english: Nandita stood up to the boys and told them that their behavior was wrong.
kokborok: Nandita ah chwrairokni bwkhak saka bachakha tei borokno sakha je bohrokni tongmung chaya hwnwi.

english: The boys were surprised by Nandita's courage, and they backed down.
kokborok: Ah chwrairok Nanditani khakrak bai uanalaijak wngkha, tei bohrok ungkuluk usulkha.

english: A seed is a small, dormant plant embryo that is capable of developing into a new plant under the right conditions.
kokborok: Kaisa bwchwlwi wngkha chikonsa, phopjak buphang uaphang embryo je hamkrai khainani mannai wngkha kaisa kwtal buphang uaphang tola ah kubui tonghalokrok bisingtwih.

english: When a seed sprouts, it begins to grow roots and shoots.
kokborok: Jephuru kaisa bwchwlwi bumuk permarok, omo yarwngrok torma tei buphang bokchorok bwkhak chengmanirok.

english: The roots anchor the plant in the soil and absorb water and nutrients from the ground.
kokborok: Ah yarwngrok ah buphang uaphangno ha bising songthang khayo tei twi kusupbo tei ha ni simi chahkohlomrok khayo.

english: The shoots grow upwards towards the sun, and the leaves begin to photosynthesize, producing food for the plant.
kokborok: Ah buphang bokchorok sakabwkhangrok torwi ah salni ganarwi thango, tei ah bwlairok photosynthesize bwkhak chengo, ah buphang uaphang bagwi chathaih thaihrwmani.

english: As the plant grows, it develops a stem, leaves, flowers, and fruit.
kokborok: Ah buphang uaphang torkheno, omo kaisa bosok, bwlairok, khumrok, tei bwthaih hamkrairok khayo.

english: The flowers produce seeds, which are dispersed by wind, water, or animals.
kokborok: Ah khumrok bwchwlwirok thaihrwo, bomo nokbar, twi, eba malmatarok bai saharjak wngkha.

english: When a seed lands in a suitable location, it can germinate and begin the process of growth all over again.
kokborok: Jephuru kaisa bwchwlwi subhida thayo karijago, omo bumuk perma tei ah tormani tangsep jotto tei waisa chengwi mano.

english: The process of seed germination is a marvel of nature.
kokborok: Ah bwchwlwi bumuk permani tangsep wngkha kaisa habar wanamasingsa.

english: It is a testament to the power of life and the resilience of the natural world.
kokborok: Omo wngkha kaisa thwiswimung ah langmani phan bwkhak tei ah habar hayung phorphor bagwi.

english: When a seed sprouts, it is a sign of hope and new beginnings.
kokborok: Jephuru ah bwchwlwi bumuk permarok, omo wngkha kaisa khajamung mari tei kwtal chengmanirok.

english: Grace: Can you tell me a little bit about its history?
kokborok: Grace: Nwng ano oboni laibumano twywi kisa sauide mano?

english: Teacher: Of course. Tea originated in China, where it has been cultivated for over 5,000 years.
kokborok: Phwrwngnai: Aow. Cha-ni achaimung Chin-o, obo aro bisi ba-saini kwbang jora romwi kaijagui 5, 000 tongo.

english: The first written record of tea dates back to the 3rd century BC, when it was mentioned in a Chinese medical text.
kokborok: Cha-ni puila swiui tisamung khristo achaimani bisira tham swkangni, jephuru obono Chin-ni bithini bijapo khursajakmani.

english: Tea was originally used as a medicinal herb, but it quickly became a popular drink among Chinese people of all social classes.
kokborok: Sana thangkhe chah dalsa bithi bwrai hwnwi samungo phwnangjakmani, phiya obo daktino jotto hoda beremni chin-ni borokrokni bisingo lukuni nwngjaknai wngwi bwchakha.

english: Grace: What about outside of China? When did tea start to spread to other parts of the world?
kokborok: Grace: Chin-ni phatarokhe bahai? Cha hayungni kubun amchairogo buphuru pirjaknani chengkha?

english: Teacher: Tea was first introduced to Europe in the 16th century by Portuguese traders.
kokborok: Phwrwngnai: Bisira chidogo Europe-o Portoguese baniya khwlainairok-baikhe puila cha chengjakmani.

english: It quickly became popular among European elites, and by the 18th century, tea had become a staple of British culture.
kokborok: Obo daktino Europeni sisukjakrokni bising, , lukuni wngwi bwchakha tei 18th bisira chichar joratwi cha British hukumuni kaisa bwkhak kotor wngwi bwchakha.

english: In the 19th century, tea was also introduced to North America, where it became a popular drink among both colonists and Native Americans.
kokborok: Bisira 19th chichukuo, salsi America-obo cha chengjakmani, obo aro colony khaui tongnairok tei americao achainairok kainwini bisingo lukuni nwngjaknai wngwi bwchakha.

english: Grace: That's really interesting.I never knew that tea had such a long history.
kokborok: Grace: Obo kwkubuino khwnathotok. Ang uaisaphano saimanyakho je cha-ni aswk kothoma kolok kaisa tongo.

english: Teacher: It's a fascinating story, and it's one that's still being written today.
kokborok: Phwrwngnai: Obo khwnathotok kothoma, tei obo tabukbo swijagwi tongkho.

english: Dentist: Let me take a look. [Examines the patient's teeth.] Hmm, it looks like you have a cavity.
kokborok: Bua hayapha" ano kisa naina rid. [rogini bua amjogwi naikha.] hmm, omo naimani nini ro bwlah tongma kahai.

english: I'm going to need to drill out the decay and fill the hole.
kokborok: Ang bwlah no khurwi karina bwkhak thangna nanganw tei bwlamno supungna nanganw.

english: Patient: Will it hurt?
kokborok: Rogi: omo twda sano?

english: Dentist: It might be a little uncomfortable, but I'll do my best to make it as painless as possible.
kokborok: Bua hayapha: omo kisa tongthokya wngwimano, phiya ang ani jora twi jur rinai jetwi sayawui swnam manai.

english: Dentist: (gives the patient a local anesthetic) Okay, this will numb the area so you won't feel anything.
kokborok: Bua hayapha:(rogino oroni anesthetic rwkha) ako, omo oh ari o bormanya khaiyanw je nwng mungsaphanao wngjakgwlak.

english: Dentist: (drills out the decay and fills the hole) All done!
kokborok: Bua hayapha: (bwlah no khurwi karikha tei bwlamno supungkhe) jotto paikha!

english: Patient: Thank you, doctor. That wasn't so bad.
kokborok: Rogi: hambai nono, saknainai. abo aswkbo hamya wngya.

english: Dentist: You're welcome. Just be sure to brush and floss regularly to prevent future cavities.
kokborok: Bua hayapha: phaikaham nono bo. kubuino haino bua hudi tei joglukdi salbrumno thinango bwlahno babai katinani.

english: Patient: I will Dentist: (hands the patient a list of instructions) Here are some instructions on how to care for your new filling.
kokborok: Rogi: ang khainai bua hayapha: (rogino mungremni phunukmani yapharkha) iko oro kisa phunukmani tongo bahaikh nini kwtal supungmanino naikolnai.

english: Patient: Thank you.
kokborok: Rogi: hambai nono.

english: Translation has many benefits, including increasing the relative value of content, improving accessibility, and opening up new markets.
kokborok: Translation ni kwbangma manmari tongu, solaimani morok content bangrimanino khobwi, chasamani sogwimani, tei kwtal hartirogo khulukmani.

english: When content is translated, it becomes accessible to a wider audience, which can lead to increased sales and profits.
kokborok: Jephuru content translated khaijago, omo kuar nainairokni bwkhak sogwijak wngwi thango, phalma tei manmari phasing bangrw'ui mano.

english: In addition, translation can help to build relationships with customers in other countries and cultures.
kokborok: Jora rwmung, translation painai bororok bai halomani tisatani chubai mano kubuni hakotor tei humuku rokbai.

english: By displaying content in multiple languages, businesses can show that they are committed to reaching a global audience.
kokborok: Dalbidal kokrokni content phunujakmabai, beparrok phunuk mano je bohrok yapharjakma wngkha hayungrwgwi nainai rokni thani sogwinani.

english: This can help to build trust and credibility with potential customers.
kokborok: Omo nujakya painai borokrokni bising poito tei credibility swnamna bagwi chubachu manwi mano.

english: Here are some specific examples of how translation has benefited businesses: * A small business that sells handmade jewelry translated its website into Spanish, French, and German.
kokborok: iko oro kisa specific phunukmari bahai khe phunukmani beparrogo manmarikha: * kaisa chikonsa bepar je yakbai swnnamjak kanjaknai translated khai phalo website o Spanish, French, tei German bai.

english: As a result, it saw a significant increase in sales from international customers * A large corporation that manufactures medical devices translated its product manuals into multiple languages.
kokborok: Phaithago, phatarhani painai borokrokni thani oro phalma thaino rwgwi nangkukmani bangmung nukjakha * kaisa kotor corporation je sakham manwi swnammarok dalbidal kokrokno yakbai omoni duna bwthaih tangjaknairok kokswlayo.

english: This helped to ensure that doctors and nurses in other countries could use the devices safely and effectively * A nonprofit organization that provides humanitarian aid translated its brochures and websites into dozens of languages.
kokborok: Omo oro khasrai khlaima khai je chubachu manma khunni hakotorrokni saknairok tei hamya naikolnairok devices katirwi tei sago kwlaiya khgai phwangwi mano * Kaisa manmarikwrwi motha je borokrokno chubam jag bagjago bini translated brochures tei websites rokni bising chwnwi kokrokno phwnango.

english: This helped to reach people in need who would not have otherwise been able to access the organization's resources.
kokborok: Omo nangmani borokrokni aro chubachu sogwikha hayakhe je motharokni tanglamo sogwinani khomota kwrwi rokni bagwi.

english: Translation is a powerful tool that can help businesses to grow and succeed.
kokborok: Translation kaisa phangwnangkol je bepar rokno torwnani tei khlaimanmano chubai mano.

english: Work is worship is a principle that states that all work, no matter how menial or insignificant it may seem, is sacred.
kokborok: Samung wngkha khulumjakthai hwnwi hwnjakmani, abo jeswk phano samung kotoi eba hamthaya phano wngthwng, abono borom rwthai.

english: It is a belief that every task we perform, from cooking dinner for our children to cleaning the house, is an opportunity to honor God and our fellow man.
kokborok: Omo bo kaisa poito chajago bebak samung chwng khwlaimarog, chini chwrairokni bagwi horni chamung sung mani simi nok kwchwng khwlaima jora, abo kaisa Kaitorno tei chwnghai borokno borom rwna sep manma se kwlayo.

english: When we work with this mindset, we approach our tasks with a sense of reverence and respect.
kokborok: Omo hai uasokmungrok bai samung khwlai khe, chini samungno borom rwma bisingtwi chengsa mase kwlayo.

english: We take pride in our work and do our best to do it well.
kokborok: Chini samung bai chwng kungchugo tei kaham khe khwlaisokna bagwi kaham ma khwlayo.

english: We also become more mindful of the people who will benefit from our work, and we are more likely to go the extra mile to make sure that it is done well.
kokborok: Chini samung ni bisingtwi kebo borok hamcha'ui tongkhe abono bo chwng uansok thai kwlayo, abo baino chwng teibo lama kwchal sogwinai kaham khwlaimani bisingtwi.

english: Working as worship can also help us to connect with our families and communities.
kokborok: Samungno khuluma hai khe tangmani abo chini nukhungni tei hodani borokrogbai kwrwng thani chukrw wi mano.

english: When we cook dinner for our children, we are not only providing them with nourishment, but we are also spending time with them and teaching them about the importance of food and family.
kokborok: Chini chwrairokni bagwi chwng horni chamung sungmani, abo chwng bohrokno naikol mani simi bai thakmani kwlaiya, phiya chwng bohrok bai jora swbaimani tei chamung bai nukhungno twywi bwswk joratwi nangwi tong abono phwrwng mase kwlayo.

english: When we clean the house, we are not only making our living space more comfortable, but we are also creating a sense of order and peace.
kokborok: Chwng nok kwchwng khwlai mani, abo chwng chini tongkhor no tontho-thok khwlaimani simiya, phiya chwng khakchangmano swnamani se kwlayo.

english: Work is worship is a powerful principle that can transform our lives and our relationships.
kokborok: Samung wngkha khulumjakthai hwnmani abo belai kok kotor abo chini langmani halog bothanio swlaimung tubui mano.

english: When we work with this mindset, we can find meaning and purpose in even the most mundane tasks.
kokborok: O uansokmungrok bai samung khwlai khe, samung tangna bwkha kwrwi wngwi tongma jora o phano chwng aboni sosol naharmung no saimanai.

english: Action films have undergone a major transformation in recent years.
kokborok: Samung tokerok kaisa kotor swlaijakmani tongo laithangma bisirokni bising tolathangkha.

english: Gone are the days of simple, one-dimensional heroes and villains.
kokborok: Ah khakepleng salrok thangkha, kaisa-banukmung sengrakrok tei themrangrok wngkha.

english: Today's action films are more complex, with characters who undergo significant transformations over the course of the film.
kokborok: Tinini samung tokerok wngkha teibo kutuk, tomung bai je nangmani swlaijakmarokni ah tokeni swrwngthai sakao tolathango.

english: This transformation is often a reflection of the film's themes, which can range from the importance of family to the power of love.
kokborok: Ah swlaijakmani wngkha uramuram kaisa tokeni kokbwkhakrokni kiphilmani, bono ah nukhung nangkukma simi ah hamjakma phan bwkhak rem mano.

english: Several recent action films have featured this type of transformation.
kokborok: Juda laithangma samung tokerok oh swlaijakmani sapokthaih mwkhang tongo.

english: In the film "The Batman," for example, the title character goes from being a vengeful vigilante to a symbol of hope for the city of Gotham.
kokborok: Ah toke bising "tokbagh borok, " phunukmari karwi, ah swimung tomung kisa yagul samung sichajak wngjak simi thango kaisa khajamungni mari ah Gotham doyung bagwi.

english: In "Black Panther," T'Challa must learn to embrace his role as king of Wakanda, even though it means giving up some of his personal freedoms.
kokborok: "Kosom Mwsasampari, " bising T'Challa Wakananda ni bubagra bini tangmung lamsokma bwkhak ma swrwngnai, ahaino haiphano omo kokmarok bini baksa sakphang phiyokjak yakarmani.

english: And in "Captain Marvel," Carol Danvers must learn to control her powers and use them for good.
kokborok: Tei "tangokra unamansingsa, " o Carol Danvers bini pharokrokno kaswkma bwkhak ma swrwngnai tei bohrokno kahamni bagwi phwnangdi.

english: These films show that action films can be more than just mindless violence.
kokborok: Oh tokerok phunukma je samung tokerok haino buchiya bulaimung salai teibo wngmano.

english: They can also be used to explore complex themes and characters.
kokborok: Bohrok kwtal karima kutuk kokbwkhakrok tei tongmungrok bwkhak bo phwnangjak mano.

english: Animal cruelty is the intentional infliction of pain, suffering, or death upon an animal.
kokborok: Malmata satokmani wngkha saimantwtwi sukmani sama, dukhumanmani, eba kaisa malmata thwimung sakao.

english: It can take many forms, from physical abuse to neglect.
kokborok: Omo kwbangma sakmang nai mano, sakno twi satokma simi saknangya bwkhak.

english: Animals may be beaten, kicked, burned, starved, or even killed for no reason other than human entertainment.
kokborok: Malmatarok bujak mano, lathirwma, khamma, ok khwima, eba kubuni borokrok tongthokmungni slai mungsa kok kwrwi phano haino bwtharjakma.

english: Animal cruelty is a serious problem that affects millions of animals every year.
kokborok: Malmata satokmani wngkha kaisa kubui kebengmung je bisi thwgwi chirasai malmatarok gwdalmarok.

english: It is illegal in most countries, but enforcement is often lax.
kokborok: Omo jottoni slai hakotorni bising lamchaya, phiya phanbai khlaimani wngkha uramuram luthur.

english: There are many organizations that work to prevent and stop animal cruelty, but more needs to be done.
kokborok: Aro kwbangma motharok tongo je kasogra bwkha samung khayo tei malmata satokmani mwthakma, phiya teibo khlaina bwkhak nango.

english: We can all help to stop animal cruelty by being more aware of the issue and by speaking out against it.
kokborok: Chwng jotto malmata satokmani mwthakna bwkhak chubai mano ah swirwma teibo saimanma wngjak bai tei omo kebengwi samani bai.

english: We can also choose to buy from businesses that do not support animal cruelty and to support organizations that work to protect animals.
kokborok: Chwng beparirokni simi paihna bwkhak bo saimano je malamata satokmani nangmani khaiya tei motharokno nangmani bwkhak je malmatarokno mwthangna bwkhak samung khaimani.

english: Animal cruelty is a terrible thing that happens every day.
kokborok: Malmata satokmani wngkha kaisa kirimasinsa manwi je jotto salo wngmarok.

english: We can all help to make a difference by speaking out against it and by supporting organizations that work to stop it.
kokborok: Chwng jotto kaisa pherlaimung swnamma bwkhak chubai mano omo kebengwi ongkhor samani bai tei motharokno nangmani bai je omono mwthakna bwkhak samung khaimani.

english: Black is a color that has been used throughout history to represent both power and oppression.
kokborok: Kosom wngkha kaisa pali je laihbuma bisingtwih phwnangjagwi phayo kainwi phan tei satokmani adong wngkha bwkhak.

english: In ancient Egypt, black was associated with the god Osiris, who was the ruler of the underworld.
kokborok: Kwcham Egypt o, kosom wngkha Osiris mwtai bai gwdaljak, je khilwng no hanaikolnai.

english: In the Christian tradition, black is often associated with death and mourning.
kokborok: Christian wngphanai, kosom uramuram thwimung tei khanangmung bai gwdaljak.

english: However, black has also been used as a symbol of strength and resilience.
kokborok: Haiphano, kosom wngkha kaisa mari phan tei resilience bai phwnangjagwi phayo.

english: In the civil rights movement, black was the color of choice for many activists, who saw it as a way to represent their determination to fight for equality.
kokborok: Ah luku manthairok ninangrimung bising, kosom wngkha kwbangma samung-humungni bagwi saijak pali, je omo no kaisa lama bwkhak borokni khathonmani bwkahk bulaimani baksani bagwi nukha.

english: Today, black is still a complex and multifaceted color.
kokborok: Tini, kosom tabukbo kaisa kutuk tei jadrepod pali.

english: It can be seen as a symbol of both good and evil, beauty and ugliness, power and oppression.
kokborok: Omo kaisa mari kainwi kaham tei hamya khe nukjak mano, naithok tei sitrama, phan tei satokmani.

english: But perhaps more than anything else, black is a color that represents the human experience.
kokborok: Phiya haiphano jesamanwi sei kwbang, kosom wngkha kaisa pali je borok saimanmano adong wngmarok khayo.

english: It is a color that we all share, regardless of our race, religion, or nationality.
kokborok: Omo wngkha kaisa pali je chwng jotto baklayo, chini chini bosong khaurya, tongthar eba hodaphalam.

english: As the world becomes increasingly diverse, black is becoming a more important color in our culture.
kokborok: Ahaino ah hayung bangrwmani baksaya wngmarok, kosom kaisa teibo nangkukma pali chini hukumu bising wngmani.

english: As I walked through the crowded festival grounds, I couldn't help but smile.
kokborok: Ang ah bohrokkwbang ter harok twih himwi thangkheno, ang mwnwiya tongwi manliya.

english: The sun was shining, the music was blaring, and everyone was wearing their sunglasses and eyeglasses.
kokborok: Ah sal chwngmani wngkha, ah rwchapmung wngkha khorangchiringmani, tei jottono bohrokni mokolsisirok tei salsisirok thupmani wngkha.

english: It was like a sea of color and style, and it made me feel happy to be a part of it.
kokborok: Omo wngkha kaisa twibom pali tei tongdal kahai, tei omo ano kaisa omoni bokcho wngna bwkhak tongthok wansukmung swnamo.

english: I saw people wearing all sorts of different glasses, from simple, round frames to elaborate, cat-eye shapes.
kokborok: Ang jotto rwngremrok juda juda sisirok borokno thupmani nukha, kiting framerok uarrwma bwkhak, aming-mokol banokmarok.

english: There were sunglasses in every color of the rainbow, and some people even had glasses that lit up or changed colors.
kokborok: Aro salsisirok tongjak jotto pali chokhereng bising, tei baksa borok ahaino sisirok tongo je chwngsama eba palirok swlaijakma.

english: It was like a fashion show, and I couldn't help but admire everyone's unique style.
kokborok: Omo wngkha kaisa kachum kahai, tei ang sak chubai manliya phiya jottoni solya tongdal lopkha.

english: I stopped to talk to a woman who was wearing a pair of bright yellow sunglasses.
kokborok: Ang bwrwima khoroksa bai kok sana bwkhak bathakha je kaisa bojro kwchwng kormo salsisirok thupmani wngkha.

english: She told me that she loved wearing sunglasses because they made her feel more confident and stylish.
kokborok: Boh ano sakha je boh salsisirok thupnani hamjago tamni hinma bohrok bono teibo khakrak tei tongdalma wansukmung swnamo.

english: She said that she always felt like she was wearing a costume when she didn't have her glasses on, and that they helped her to express her personality.
kokborok: Boh sakha je boh homnino kaisa richum kanamni wansukma kahai wngkha jephuru bo bini sisirok thupjakya phuru, tei je bohrok bono bini saksuar muchungsama bwkhak chubakha.

english: I continued on my way, and I couldn't help but feel more optimistic about the world.
kokborok: Ang choyai karwi ani himlan thangkha, tei ang sakno chubai manliya phiya ah hayungni bagwi teibo khachongmung wansukkha.

english: Karim and Abed had been friends since they were kids.
kokborok: Karim bai Abed chwrai phangsini simi bayap wngphaimani.

english: They grew up together, went to the same schools, and even played on the same sports teams.
kokborok: Bohrok thansa khe torkha, rwngnogo baska no thangkha, tei borok thwngdol baksa kheno thwngmung thwngkha.

english: They had a bond that was like no other.
kokborok: Bohrokni kwthalaima hai tei kubunrok solya.

english: They could talk about anything, and they always knew that they could count on each other.
kokborok: Bohrok jesphano twi kok saimano, tei bohrok saimano bohrok khoroksa tei khoroksa no goni mano.

english: One day, Karim was diagnosed with cancer.
kokborok: Salsa, Karim cancer bemar manjakha.

english: He was devastated, but he knew that he had Abed to lean on.
kokborok: Bo sakbaijakha, phiya bo saimano je bini thani Abed logi tongo.

english: Abed was there for him every step of the way, through the surgeries, the chemotherapy, and the radiation.
kokborok: Abed bini jotto yapri sehma lama bini logi tongo, rachikjakphuru, chemotheraphy, tei radiation.

english: He never left Karim's side, and he always gave him hope.
kokborok: Bo Karim ni gandar ni yakarya, tei bo bono homnino khajamung rio.

english: Karim eventually beat cancer, and he and Abed were closer than ever.

kokborok: Nwng nini nukhung sakao solar panels thepamani bai omo khai mano, kaisa nokbar turbine paimani, eba kaisa kwkhrang pherang thong nini nangmung company ni bagwi tailriwui.

english: You can also reduce your energy consumption by unplugging appliances when you're not using them, turning off the lights when you leave a room, and using energy-efficient appliances.
kokborok: Nwng nini tangphan charimani bo khairiwui mano manwirok khulukmani jephuru nwng bohrokno phwnangya wngmani, pohorrokno mwthakmani nwng jephuru nok yakar phuru, tei tangphang-nangma manwirok phwnangmani.

english: Three women are sitting at a table, talking about their cats.
kokborok: Khoroktham bwrwima rok kaisa songphang o achuk tongo, bohrokni aming ni bagwi koksalayo tonglayo.

english: Constance: My cat, Sangeetha, is always there to greet me at the door when I come home from work.
kokborok: Constance: ani aming, Sangeetha, ano homnino lamsokna bagwi duklam bwskang tong jephuru ang samungni nogo kiphil phuru.

english: Ayanda: Me too! I have two cats of my own. They make me feel wanted.
kokborok: Ayanda: ani bo! ani maknwi sakbaithangni amingrok tongo. bohrok ano nango hwnwi wansukrio.

english: Constance: I know what you mean. Sangeetha always makes me feel better when I'm having a bad day.
kokborok: Constance: ang saimano nwng tamo sananai. Sangeetha ano homnino kaham wansukrio jephhuru ani sal hamya wngkhe.

english: Aditi: I've always wanted a cat, but I'm allergic.
kokborok: Aditi: angbo aming kaisa nana muchungmano, phiya ang allergic.

english: Ayanda: That's too bad. Cats are really great companions.
kokborok: Ayanda: abo belai chaya. aming rok kubuino kotor logisong.

english: Aditi:I know! I've always admired people who have cats. They seem to have such a special bond with their pets.
kokborok: Aditi: ang saimano! ang homnino aming toninai borok rokno borom rwi naisigo. bohrok bohrokni rwjak mal bai kaisa mahmlai khathailama nukjak tongo.

english: Constance: I think it's because cats are very independent animals. They don't need you to take care of them every minute of the day.
kokborok: Constance: ang wansukma khe haisi omo tamini hinmale belai phiyokjak malmatarok. bohrokno salo srapsa khai nono bohrokno naikolna nangya.

english: But they still love you and enjoy your company.
kokborok: Phiya bohrok tophano nono hamjago tei nini logi tongna hamjago.

english: Two men, one in his 30s and one in his 50s, are sitting at the bar, drinking.
kokborok: Chwla khoroknwi, khoroksa bini 30'o tei khoroksa bini 50'o, bar'o achugwi tongo, nwngwi tongo.

english: Young Man: So, I heard that the new head of the liquor board is really cracking down on local stores.
kokborok: Chwla sikla: ahaino, ang khwnakha je kwtal bokhorok arak kwprap naikolmotha oroni khatinok rogo kubuino baiyui kwlai tongkha.

english: Old Man: Yeah, I heard that too. They're saying that he's going to be doing random inspections of bars and restaurants to make sure that they're not selling liquor to minors.
kokborok: Boora borok: In', angbo hai hwnwi no khwnao. bohrok saitongo je bo klaijak bars no naikolnai tei chahnok rogo wngkubui khaidi je bohrok omor kasukya rokno arak kwprap taphalthwng hwnwi.

english: Young Man: That's a good thing.
kokborok: Chwla sikla: abo kaisa manwi kaham.

english: I mean, it's not fair to the responsible businesses that are following the rules when some other places are just selling liquor to anyone who walks in the door.
kokborok: Ang kusu, omo belai chaya beparirok bokjak bwkhak je raida twi rwthartongmani jephuru baksa kubun thayo haino arak kwprap phalwi tongmani jesaphano duklam bising twi himwi phaikhe.

english: Old Man: I agree. But I'm also worried about how it's going to affect my business.
kokborok: Boora borok: ang gosio. phiya ang bo wanajak bahaikhe ani bepar rogo nangrwi tongo.

english: I mean, I'm a good guy. I don't sell liquor to minors.
kokborok: Ang kusu, ang kaham borok, ang omoksukya rokno arak kwprap phalya.

english: But I'm also not going to let some government bureaucrat tell me who I can and can't sell liquor to.
kokborok: Phiya ang bo haino haphang haphangtangphang no sanariya ang sabono arak kwprap phalwi man tei sabono no phalwi manya.

english: Young Man: I get what you're saying. But you have to be careful.
kokborok: Chwla sikla: ang saimankha nwng tamo sananai. Phiya nwng belai naikini khaina nangnai.

english: It's important to remember that dog attacks are rare, and that most dogs are well-behaved and loving creatures.
kokborok: Obo muitu narwkthai je swihni chopromung aswk nukjakya, tei kwbangkuk swihno tomung kaham tong tei hamjakthotok.

english: However, there are certain circumstances that can increase the risk of a dog attack, such as if the dog is not properly trained, if it is feeling threatened, or if it is in a confined space.
kokborok: Haiphano, kisaswk tonghalok tongo jebo swih chopromungni kirimungno bangrwo, romdi tumung swih masano kahamkhe loi phwrwngjakya, tumung bohno sikrio hwnwi uansukkhe eba boh ari khajak thayo tongo hinkhe.

english: In the case of the recent dog attack in which a grandmother was killed, it appears that the dog was not properly trained and that it was feeling threatened by the grandmother's presence.
kokborok: Jora kisa swkango swih chopromani patimung, je patimungo khoroksa chw-chwi thwijamani, obono nugwi hai matongo je o swihno kahamkhe loi phwrwngjakliya tei boh chw-chwini tongmano sikrimung hwnwi khachongkha.

english: The dog was a large, powerful breed that had been adopted from a shelter just a few months before the attack.
kokborok: Oh swih kotor, phangwnang dalni tongmani, o swihno chopromani tal kisa swkangno tongthaini simi naharjakmani.

english: The grandmother had been visiting her son and his family, and she was sitting on the couch when the dog suddenly attacked her.
kokborok: Oh chwi bwsajwla tei bini nukhungni borokrokbai malainani thangmani tei boh sofao achukjak tongmani jephuru o swih atomsa bohno choprophayo.

english: The dog bit her multiple times on the head and neck, and she died at the scene.
kokborok: Oh swih bini khorok tei godwnao uaikwbang uarkha tei patimung thayono boh thwijakha.

english: The dog's owner has said that he was unaware of any history of aggression in the dog, and that he believes the attack was triggered by the grandmother's sudden movement.
kokborok: Oh swihni bugra sakha je boh swihni jolimungni laibumano twywi mungsaphano saimanya tongmani tei boh poito khwlayo je chwini atomsa lorisori wngmani jarwi choprojakha.

english: However, it is important to note that even well-trained dogs can become aggressive if they are not properly socialized or if they are feeling threatened.
kokborok: Haiphano, obono muitu narwkthai je loi phwrwngjak swihrokphano choprobwimano tumung bohrokno lukurokni bwskango tubujakya hinkhe eba bohrok sikrio hwnwi uansukkhe.

english: This tragic incident highlights the importance of responsible dog ownership.
kokborok: Oh kirimasingsa patimung poja gwnang swihni nokphangni nangkukmano romwi tisao.

english: The sci-fi movie industry has been on a downward slide in recent years, with fewer and fewer films being produced.
kokborok: Ah Sci-fi toke swnammung thangnai bisirok bising tola goirok tongo, kisasa bai tei kisasa tokerok phunuk tongjago.

english: In fact, a recent study by the Motion Picture Association of America found that the number of sci-fi films released in theaters declined from 20 in 2010 to just 10 in 2015.
kokborok: Kubuio, kaisa thangnai porima bai ah America ni thakya mangpili motha mankha je ah sci-fi tokerokni lombor theaters bising phiyokjakmani lonkha 2010 o 20 tei 2015 o 10 haino.

english: There are a number of reasons for this decline, including the rise of superhero movies and the increasing popularity of streaming services.
kokborok: Oh tola kwlaimungni ungkulugo kwbangma kok tongo, ah superhero tokerokni kasamungno khobwinai tei Streaming suarimungrokni ah lukuhamjakma bangmani.

english: Superhero movies have become increasingly popular in recent years, thanks to the success of franchises like the Marvel Cinematic Universe and the DC Extended Universe.
kokborok: Superhero tokerok thangnai bisirokni bising lukuhamjakma belai bangkha, hambai mayapharo Marvel Cinematic Universe tei DC Extented Universe rok hai franchiserokno.

english: These films offer audiences a mix of action, adventure, and spectacle that is often lacking in sci-fi films.
kokborok: Omo tokerok nainairokno yapharma kaisa tangmung dalokma, saktwikarjak, tei naijaknai je ahaino sci-fi tokerogo biyalmani khayo.

english: Streaming services have also had a negative impact on the sci-fi movie industry.
kokborok: Streaming suarimungrok kaisa ah sci-fi toke swnamnung saka kaisa chaya dagarlaima tongwi mano.

english: These services offer a wide variety of content, including sci-fi films, at a relatively low cost.
kokborok: Oh suarimungrok yapharma kaisa kuar dalbidal khakwchang, sci-fi tokerok khobwinai, kaisa hacher swk nainathangkhe.

english: This makes it more difficult for sci-fi films to compete in theaters, where they are often priced at a premium.
kokborok: Omo teibo 3 sci-fi tokerok theaters bising bataima bwkhak obo swnamjago, boro bohrok haino kaisa khatiyakpai swk khayo.

english: As a result of these factors, the sci-fi movie industry is in need of a major shake-up.
kokborok: Oh bwchwlwirok kaisa thaihmung bai, ah sci-fi toke swnamnung kaisa jottor sakbwkhak-jangrina nango.

english: Paul was an adolescent who was always getting into trouble.
kokborok: Paul wngkha khoroksa sikla je homnino supruna bisingo manjagwi tongkha.

english: He was always getting into fights, drinking, and skipping school.
kokborok: Bo hominino bulaimarok, nwngmani, tei rwngnok karmani bisingo manjagwi tongkha.

english: One day, he was drinking with his friends when they decided to go to the Trump rally.
kokborok: Salsa, bo bini bayaprok bai nwngwi tongmani jephuru borok Trump kuthumrwma bwkhak thangna chongkha.

english: They got there and started chanting "lock her up" and "build the wall" Paul was having a great time until he saw a sign that said "no minors" He realized that he was too young to be there, and he started to panic.
kokborok: Bohrok aro thangkha tei rwchapnani chengkha "bono chopdi" tei kaisa mari nukha je sakha "kebo chwrairokya" bo buchikha je bo belai omorkisa oro tongnani, tei bo kirijakna chengkha.

english: He tried to leave, but the crowd was too big.
kokborok: Bo yakarn bwkhak chaitokkha, phiya ah kuthumungrok belai kotor.

english: He was stuck there, and he didn't know what to do.
kokborok: Bo aro kwchakha, tei bo saimanliya tamo khainai.

english: Suddenly, a woman came up to him and asked him if he was okay.
kokborok: Atuma, khoroksa bwrwima bini bwkha phaikha tei bono swngkha tumungno bo thikda hwnwi.

english: Paul told her that he was lost and didn't know how to get home.
kokborok: Pual bono sakha je bo kwmaka tei saimanliya bahaikhe nok bwkhak thangnai.

english: The woman helped Paul find his way out of the crowd, and she gave him her phone number in case he ever needed help again.
kokborok: Ah bwrwima Paulno bini lama naitukna karina chubakha ah kuthummungni, tei bo bo bono bini phone lombor rwkha jodi bo jephuru teisa waisa chubachuk nangkhe.

english: In the past few years, there have been a number of cases of home invasions, natural disasters, and other emergencies that have left people without their homes.
kokborok: Kisisa lai thangjak bisi o, kwbangma jwngjal nangwi thang kha nogo khogwi habjak mani, binibo jwngjal kotor nangmani, tei kubun nangkukmani bisingtwi borokrogno nok kwrwi khwlai mani.

english: In many of these cases, the victims were not prepared for the event and had to spend a long time recovering.
kokborok: Omo hai kwbangma wngma jorao, o patemung manjaknairok tiyar kwrwi tei aboni bagwino jora kwdwk romwi kaham ma khwlayo.

english: In order to help people better prepare for these events, a number of companies have developed products and services that can help secure the home.
kokborok: O patemungrogno twywi borokrogno tiyar khwlaina bagwi , kwbangma companyrok manwi tei samung khwlaijak kari kha nukhungno mwthangna bagwi.

english: These products range from security systems to flood-proof safes, and they can help to protect people's homes and belongings in the event of a crime, disaster, or emergency.
kokborok: O manwirok wng kha twikotor ni yokjaknai manwi, tei abohrok borokni nukhung tei borokni manwirogno o jwngjalni katerw wi mano, jwngjal kotor, eba nangkukma jora ni bo.

english: One of the most important things to consider when choosing a home security system is the type of crime that is most common in your area.
kokborok: Jwngjal jorao nukhungno mwthangwi narwkjaknai kaida khe amchayo patemung patekukmanirogno kate mani abose bebakni swlai nangkugo.

english: If you live in a high-crime area, you may want to consider a system that includes features like motion sensors and cameras.
kokborok: Belai jwngjal patekukma amchairogo nwng tongwi tong khe, nwng omo hai manwi motion sensors tei camerarok tongna nango.

english: If you live in an area that is prone to natural disasters, you may want to consider a system that is designed to withstand high winds and flooding.
kokborok: Tumung nwng binibo jwngjal kotor wngnai abo hai tongthairogo tongwi tongkhe, nobar kotorma phawibo mungsa wngya tei twi kotor wngwi bo mungsa wngya abotwi swnamjak thayo tongna nangnai.

english: No matter what type of home security system you choose, it is important to make sure that it is installed and maintained properly.
kokborok: Nwng jeswk phano nukhung mwthangjaknai lama saiwi na'ui bo, nangkukmani khe abono kaham khe naikani khwlai thai.

english: A poorly installed system can be more of a hindrance than a help.
kokborok: Nwng abono kaham khe naikani khwlaiya khe abo teibo nono hamya khwlaiwi mano chubamungni swlai.

english: I remember once seeing a young girl, no more than ten years old, working in a sweatshop in a developing country.
kokborok: Chwraisa bwrwi khoroksa no nugwi ang muito mano, boni bisi chi ni saka le wngsokya kho, bo kwtwi phalnogo samung khwlayo kaisa develop wngjak hakotor o.

english: She was making very little money, and her working conditions were terrible.
kokborok: Bo rang kisa se ajewi man jao, tei bo samung khwlai marok belaino khairogma singsa.

english: She was forced to work long hours, and she was not allowed to take breaks.
kokborok: Bo samung belai dam kwdwk romwi khwlai rwjago, tei bo lenglana jora bo rwjakya.

english: She was also exposed to dangerous chemicals.
kokborok: Bo belai chemical hamya ni samung o bo ma khwlayo.

english: I was very upset by what I saw, and I knew that something had to be done.
kokborok: Ang nukbomarogno twywi belai kha o tekto nangjak kha, tei ang saimano mungsaswk le khwlaina nang sinai hwnwi.

english: I started working with an organization that helps to improve the lives of workers in developing countries.
kokborok: Ang develop wngjak hakotor ni kaisa bodolo hab kha abo samung tangnairokni langmano swkangwi twlang thanio chubao.

english: We have been able to help many workers, including the young girl I saw in the sweatshop.
kokborok: Chwng kwbangma samung tangnairogno chuba'ui man kha, tei ang nukbo mani kwtwi phalnogo a chwrwisa bwrwi nobo khobwi chuba'ui man kha.

english: She is now able to attend school, and she is no longer working in the sweatshop.
kokborok: Bo tabok rwngnogo thangwi man kha, tei bo kwtwi phalnogo samung tangwina nangliya.

english: I am very proud of the work that we have done, and I know that we are making a difference in the lives of many people.
kokborok: Chwng samung khwlaimarogno twywi ang belai ma kuchungo, tei angbo saiman kha chwng kwbangma ni langma o swlaimung bo tobo kha.

english: The rising temperatures and changing precipitation patterns are making it more difficult to grow crops in some areas, while at the same time creating new opportunities for agriculture in other areas.
kokborok: Ah tungmani kasamani tei watwi kwlaimani naidalrok slaimani wngkha omo swnammani teibo 3 bwthaihrok torrwma bwkhak baksa kholarokni bising, jephuru ah baksa jora kwtal seprok swnamani kubun kholarokni bising.

english: The overall effect is that the global agricultural system is becoming more complex and less predictable.
kokborok: Ah bebagwi sago kwlaima wngkha je ah hayungrwgwi hukba lam wngkha teibo kutuk tei kisa unumanwi wngmani.

english: One of the most direct effects of climate change on agriculture is the increase in the frequency and severity of extreme weather events.
kokborok: Superhero tokerok thangnai bisirok bising lukuhamjakma belai bangwi thangkha, Marvel Cinematic Universe tei DC Extented Universe chongna manthairok khalimanmung ni bagwi hambairok yapharo.

english: Heat waves, droughts, floods, and storms can all damage crops and livestock, and make it difficult for farmers to get their crops to market.
kokborok: Kutung twirrok, khoran, twitormung, tei bankundrirok jotto bwthaih tei khatijakmal piyakmung khlaimano, tei omo chuainairok ni bagwi 3 swnam mano bohrokni bwthaihrok hati bwkhak manna bwkhak.

english: In some cases, these events can cause entire crop yields to be lost, leading to food shortages and price increases.
kokborok: Baksa tonghalokrok bising, oh wngmungrok jotto bwthaih thaihrwmarok kwmana bwkhak pher mano, abo chathaih kulukyarok tei mbangmungrokni phasing tlangmano.

english: In addition to extreme weather events, climate change is also leading to changes in the average temperature and precipitation patterns.
kokborok: Jora rwmani ah belai salbar wngmarok, nokbartwibar swlaima wngkha swlaimarok bwkha dagimani ah thumjak baksa tungmari tei watwi kwlaimani naidalrok.

english: These changes are making it more difficult to grow some crops in certain areas, while at the same time creating new opportunities for agriculture in other areas.
kokborok: Oh swlaimarok wngkha omo swnammani teibo 3 bwthaihrok torrwma bwkhak baksa kholarokni bising, jephuru ah baksa jora kwtal seprok swnamani kubun kholarokni bising.

english: For example, the warmer temperatures in some areas are making it possible to grow crops that were previously not possible, while the increased precipitation in other areas is making it possible to grow crops that were previously not feasible.
kokborok: Baksa tonghalokrok bising, oh wngmungrok jotto bwthaih thaihrwmarok kwmana bwkhak pher mano, chathaih kulukyarok tei morok bangmanirok bwkhak dagimani.

english: Many famous dictators have ruled over states throughout history.
kokborok: Laibuma kwrwngwi kwbangma mungwnang daginairok haste naikolangkha.

english: Some of the most notable include Adolf Hitler, who ruled over Nazi Germany from 1933 to 1945; Joseph Stalin, who ruled over the Soviet Union from 1922 to 1953; and Mao Zedong, who ruled over China from 1949 to 1976.
kokborok: Jottonisai khursathaini bisingo kisaswk tongo Adolf Hitler, boh chichukura thamchitham bisini simi chichukura brwichiba bisi jora Nazi Germany ha-naikolangkha 1933 to 1945; Joseph Stalin, boh chichukra nwichwnwi bisini simi chichukura bachitham bisi jora Soviet Union ha-naikolangkha1922 to 1953; tei Mao Zedong, boh chichukura brwichichuku bisini simi chichukura snichidok bisi jora Chin ha-naikolangkha 1949 to 1976.

english: These dictators were all responsible for the deaths of millions of people, and their regimes were characterized by violence, oppression, and totalitarianism.
kokborok: Oh daginairok rasai rasai borokrok thwimani bagwi bokjaknai tongmani tei bohrokni ha-naikolmung raida naslemung, satokmung, tei bebakno yapha tonmabaikhe yasi kaijago.

english: One of the most surprising things about these dictators is that they were able to maintain power for so long.
kokborok: Oh daginarokno twywi jottonisai uanamungni manwi wngkha bohrok aswk jora romwi phano tongwi manmani.

english: They were able to do this by using a combination of propaganda, intimidation, and violence.
kokborok: Ereng kok pirwi, kirirwui tei naslemungni kwrwngjakno samungo phwnagwi bohrok obohai khwlai manmani.

english: They also had the support of powerful militaries and secret police forces.
kokborok: Bohrokni thani phankwrak sengkrak bodol tei huijak police bodolni chubachubo tongmani.

english: Despite their power, these dictators were eventually overthrown.
kokborok: Bohrokni thani phan tongwi tongphano, paithago oh daginairokno mechensugwi mankha.

english: Hitler committed suicide in 1945, Stalin died of a stroke in 1953, and Mao died of natural causes in 1976.
kokborok: Hitler 1945 bisio sak-sakno butharkha, 1953 bisio Stalin stroke wngwi thwikha tei Mao 1976 bisio habarni pherbai thwikha.

english: Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist who developed the theory of relativity, one of the two pillars of modern physics (alongside quantum mechanics).
kokborok: Albert Einstein wngkha khoroksa German-achaima kokbwkraima manwisikrwrwng je ah kokbwkrai holokma hamkrai, kaisa ah kainwi kwtal manwisilam thongrok (ganagini quantum kolni kokrok).

english: His work is also known for its influence on the philosophy of science.
kokborok: Bini samung ah soisimung koksilam sakao omo koklopmung bagwi bo sinijago.

english: Einstein is best known in popular culture for his mass–energy equivalence formula E = mc2 (which has been dubbed "the world's most famous equation").
kokborok: Einstein luku hamjakjak bising kahamkuk sinijakha bini pha -kotor hainohai kobwrwng E=mc2 (bomo dubbed khaijakha "ah hayungni jottoni slai sinikukjak baksakhalaijak").

english: Einstein was born in Ulm, in the Kingdom of Württemberg, German Empire, on 14 March 1879.
kokborok: Einstein Ulm bising achai kha, ah bugraha Wuttemberg, German ha naikoljak, 14 tallang 1879.

english: He showed an early aptitude for mathematics and physics.
kokborok: Boi phunukha kaisa dakti pharimung lekhamungrok tei manwisilam bagwi.

english: In 1905, at the age of 26, Einstein published four groundbreaking papers that transformed physics.
kokborok: 1905 o, 26 omor o, Einstein kaibwrwi hakwlwirwma laihrok sapokkha je manwisilam swlaikha.

english: These include his special relativity theory, which introduced the concepts of space and time as a single unified continuum, and his general relativity theory, which proposed that gravity is not a force, but is instead a curvature of spacetime.
kokborok: Omo bini mahmlai halokma kokbwkrai khobkha, bomo ah khakamungrok bukcha tei jora kaisa saichung thumsa khlaima choyai, tei bini jottoni halokma kokbwrai, bomo sasokkha je hilikwkwk kaisa phanya, phiya aboni slai kaisa kokoimari bukchajora.

english: Einstein's work led to a new understanding of the universe, and had a profound impact on the development of modern physics.
kokborok: Einstein ni samung kaisa ah nokhayung buchimani kwtal bwkhak dagikha.

english: He received the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1921 for his explanation of the photoelectric effect.
kokborok: Bo 1921 bising manwisilam bising ah hoda kaham yakpai mankha bini ah pherangmangpili sekhrupma swibaikhrup samani karwi.

english: Einstein was a pacifist and a strong advocate for social justice.
kokborok: Einstein wngkha khoroksa kwchwngkaham tei khoroksa kwrak sualphang hodarwk mankubui bagwi.

english: You have been warned.
kokborok: Nwng sakhlaijakha.

english: You have been given a clear and concise warning.
kokborok: Nwng kaisa sraisrai tei swkadrop sakhlaimani rwjakha.

english: You have been told that if you continue to engage in this behavior, you will be banned.

kokborok: Phunukmari karwi ah sijakrwnai phwnangma wngkha sakbaihthang hamya naimung rogirokni bagwi.

english: By looking at a patient's individual data, therapists can better understand their needs and create a treatment plan that is tailored to them.
kokborok: Ah rogirokno saksakni sijarwnai naimani bai, hamya nainairok kaham buchiwui mano bohrokni nangmarok tei kaisa saknaimung chapma swnamma je bohrokno risupnai wngkha.

english: This can lead to better outcomes for patients, as they are more likely to receive the help that they need.
kokborok: Omo phatarphaimarok rogirokni bagwi kaham bwkhak dagi mano, iko bohrok teibo ahaino manna bwkhka tongo ah chubachu je bohrok nangmani.

english: One study, which was published in the journal "JAMA Psychiatry," found that patients who received personalized therapy based on their data were more likely to improve their symptoms than those who received standard therapy.
kokborok: Kaisa porimung, bomo ah kokbwlaih bising sapukjak wngkha "JAMA khabemar naimung, " manma je rogirok sabo sakbaihthangma hamya naimung mankha bohrokni yaphang sijakrwnai sakao wngkha teibo ahaino bohrokni nukswkangmarirok slai abo je tongham hamya naimung mankha.

english: The study also found that the patients who received personalized therapy were more likely to stay in treatment for longer periods of time.
kokborok: Oh porima bo mankha je ah rogirok sakabaihthangma hamya naimung mankha bohrok wngkhah teibo ahaino saknaimung bising tongna kwdwkma jora bokjak karwi.

english: This study is just one example of how data can be used to improve mental health care.
kokborok: Oh porima wngkha haino kaisa phunukmari bahai sijakrwnai khapang sakduk naikani chasama bwkhak phwnangjak wngmano.

english: As more research is done in this area, we can expect to see even more advances in the use of data to help people with mental health issues.
kokborok: iko teibo rutukrwk oh khola bising khlaijak wngkha, chwng khachongma bwkak nugwi mano tei swkangkolok ah sijakrwnai phwnangma bising borok khaphang sakduk swirwmarok bai chubama bwkhak wngo.

english: My sister is a therapist who uses data to help her patients.
kokborok: Ani bapahno wngkha khoroksa hamya nainai je bini rogirokno chubama bwkhak sijakrwnai phanango.

english: The peacock is a large and colorful bird that is native to Asia.
kokborok: Ah moyur kaisa kotorma tei palikuplung tok wngkha je Asia bwkhak achaiha wngkha.

english: It is known for its beautiful plumage, which is made up of iridescent blue, green, and purple feathers.
kokborok: Omo bini naithok bwkrangrokni bagwi sinijago, bomo chokhreng kharangjiji, kwkhwrang, tei phantok gap tokwrangrok swnamjakma wngkha.

english: Peacocks are also known for their elaborate courtship displays, which they perform to attract mates.
kokborok: Moyurok bo bohrokni uarrwma runghalok phunukma wngkha, bomo bohrok logisongno khasotonna bwkhak tangkha.

english: During these displays, the male peacock will spread his tail feathers and fan them out to create a large, colorful fan.
kokborok: Oh phunukma wngjora, ah chwla moyur bini khitung bwkwrangrok pholoknai tei borokno sipbwi karikha kaisa kotor, palikupung sipjaknai swnamma bwkhak.

english: The female peacock will then choose a mate based on the size and beauty of his tail feathers.
kokborok: Ah moyur bwrwi hwnkhe kaisa logisong sainai ah torma yaphang sakao tei naithok bini khitung tokwrwngrok bai.

english: Peacocks are also known for their intelligence and ability to learn.
kokborok: Moyurrok bo bohrokni siyankwrwng bagwi sinijak mano tei khlaimanma bwkhak swrwngo.

english: They can be trained to perform tricks and can even be taught to talk.
kokborok: Bohrok phemlokmarok tangma bwkhak phwrwngjak mano tei ahaino kok sana bwkhak phwrwnghjak mano.

english: In addition to their beauty and intelligence, peacocks are also important members of the ecosystem.
kokborok: Jora ramani bising borokni naithokma tei siyankwrwng bwkhak, moyurrok bo ah habarlam logisongrok bo nangkukma wngkha.

english: They help to control the population of insects and other pests, and their droppings can help to fertilize the soil.
kokborok: Bohrok ah yongrok bangmani tei kubunthwikumurok kasomung bwkhak chubao, tei bohrokni kwlaimanirok ah haching phas rwma bwkhak chubai mano.

english: You are my beloved Son; with you I am well pleased.
kokborok: Nwng’-no ani khajani Sajla, Nono’-no ang belai khe khá phurjago.

english: Repent and believe in the gospel.
kokborok: Norok sak-sakni tongdal tei bwkhano slái di, tei Kothoma kahamno poito khlai di.

english: Follow me and I will make you fish for people.
kokborok: Norok ani logi phai di, ang norokno á romna ya, tamo khe Kaitorni bagwi borok romnani se phrwng anw.

english: Be silent, and come out of him!
kokborok: Siringcha wng di! O borokni bisingni ongkhorwi phai di!

english: If you are willing, you can make me clean.
kokborok: Nwng muchung khe ano ham rwui mano.

english: I am willing.
kokborok: Ham di, angbo ahaino nai-o.

english: Son, your sins are forgiven.
kokborok: Chwlasa, nini bebak sumsok nakarjak kha

english: Follow me.
kokborok: Ani logi phai di

english: Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick; I have come to call not the righteous but sinners.
kokborok: Kaham borokni bagwi daktor nang ya, hamya borokni bagwi se nango. Borok kahamrokno ang ringna phai ya, sumsok gwnangrokno se ringna phai-o.

english: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old cloak; otherwise, the patch pulls away from it, the new from the old, and a worse tear is made.
kokborok: Rí kwchamo khoroksa phano rí kwtal thap ya; thap khe a rí kwtal kwchamno kichik rwui kákhlai rwnai, hakhe kwpla teibo uarnai.

english: Is it lawful for the Sabbath day?
kokborok: Sabat salo omo hai khlai laimani chini kerongni raidano swbaima klai-o.

english: Stand up here in front of everyone.
kokborok: Jotono nukna tẃi khe oro bacha di.

english: Is it lawful to do good or to do harm on the Sabbath, to save life or to kill?
kokborok: Sabat salo bú samung khlai kha hwn khe sói wngma klai: Kaham khlaima da eba hamya khlaimani? Khoroksani langma mwthangmani da sói eba butharmani?

english: Stretch out your hand.
kokborok: Nini yak pholok di.

english: You are the Son of God!
kokborok: Nwng’-no Kaitorni Sajla!

english: He has Beelzebul, and by the ruler of the demons he casts out demons.
kokborok: Soitan bini bisingo tongo! Mwtai hamya bokhorokni phan bai se bo bororokni aroni mwtai hamyarokno rwkhlai-o.

english: Who are my mother and my brothers?
kokborok: Sabo ani ama? Sabo ani takhuksong?

english: Listen!
kokborok: Khna di!

english: Let anyone with ears to hear listen!
kokborok: Khunju gwnangrok hwn kheba o kókno khna thung!

english: Pay attention to what you hear
kokborok: Norok khnaui tongmarokno bwkha rwui uansuk di.

english: For there is nothing hidden, except to be disclosed; nor is anything secret, except to come to light.
kokborok: Bebak huijak tongmarok tikhlaiwi phunukjak anw. Bebak bisingni manwirokno kariui sini rwjak anw.

english: If anyone has ears to hear, let them listen!
kokborok: Norok khunju tong khe o kókno khna di!

english: Even the wind and the sea obey him?
kokborok: Nokbar bai twi suda bini kók khnaui ma tongo?

english: Let us enter them.
kokborok: Chwng bórokni bisingo habwi tháng anw.

english: Report to them what the Lord has done for you, and how he has had mercy on you.
kokborok: Subrai nini bagwi bwswk kaham khlai kha bórokno sa bai di.

english: My little daughter is at the point of death. Come and lay your hands on her, so that she may be made well and live.
kokborok: Ani bwrwima thwina nai tong kha. Nwng phaiwi bini saka-o kisa yak bera phai ja di. Hakhe bo ham anw tei kaham kwrwng khe tongwi man anw.

english: If I but touch his clothes, I will be made well.
kokborok: Ang bini kamchwlwi kisa ma tang kheno ham anw

english: Do not fear, only believe.
kokborok: Ta kiri di; poito simi khlai di.

english: Little girl, get up!
kokborok: Talitha Kum!

english: Where did this man get all this?
kokborok: Bahai khe bo omo tẃi aswk elem man kha?

english: Prophets are not without honor, except in their hometown, and among their own kin, and in their own house.
kokborok: Diyari bini kamiyungni borok bai, bini sandairok bai tei bini nokni bororokno karwi kubun bebak jagani bororok bai’-no bórom rwjago.

english: But to wear sandals and not to put on an extra tunic.
kokborok: Yaklaprok káui mano, tamo khe rí bárarok ta tlang di.

english: I want you to give me at once the head of John the Baptist on a platter.
kokborok: Ano tabukno mairango khlaiwi baptisma rwnai Johonni bokhorok rw phai di

english: Come away to a deserted place all by yourselves and rest a while.
kokborok: Ang bai baksa phai di; siring siring jaga-o chwng simi tháng lai anw. Aro-o chwng kisa lenglaui man anw.

english: You give them something to eat.
kokborok: Bórokno chá rwna bagwi norok kisa chámung rw gra di.

english: Take heart, it is I; do not be afraid.
kokborok: Ta uana di; omo ang se! Ta kiri di.

english: And there are also many other traditions that they observe, the washing of cups, pots, and bronze kettles.
kokborok: Bórokni slái swkang tongwi tháng langnairokni raidaroknobo bórok rákhogo.

english: Why do your disciples not live according to the tradition of the elders, but eat with defiled hands?
kokborok: Bórok yak sú yaui’-no mai chá-o. Tamoni bagwi bórok omo hairok khlai?

english: This people honors me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me
kokborok: O bororok kók bai ano bórom rw-o, phiya bórokni thani-o ang mungsa buya.

english: Go home to your daughter, for the demon has left her.
kokborok: Ani thani tháng di. Mwtai hamya nwsajwkno yakarwi tháng kha.

english: Be opened.
kokborok: Ephata.

english: Why does this generation ask for a sign?
kokborok: Tamo wngwi norok soidomni samung naina hwn?

english: Watch out! Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.
kokborok: Hus wng di! Norok Pharisairokni chuan tei Herodni chuan bai hus khe tong di.

english: Can you see anything?
kokborok: Tabuk nu da nuk kha?

english: Who do people say that I am?
kokborok: Bororok ano sabo tamo hwn?

english: You are setting your mind not on divine things but on human things.
kokborok: Kaitor naimarokno nwng nangjak ya. Borok nangjakkukmano se nwng torjago.

english: If any want to become my followers, let them deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me.
kokborok: Norokni bisingo ani sagri wngna muchungnairok bórok sak sakni kók ta uansuk thung tei bini krus balwi ani logi phai thung.

english: This is my Son, the Beloved; listen to him!
kokborok: Bo’-no ani Sajla, bonono ang belai hamjak kugo. Bini kók khna di!

english: What are you arguing about with them?
kokborok: Tamono tẃiwi tokra rw laiwi tong?

english: Bring him to me.
kokborok: A chwraino ani thani tubu di!

english: Why could we not cast it out?
kokborok: Norok khe tamo wngwi a mwtai hamyano rwkhlai man li ya sla?

english: Whoever is not against us is for us.
kokborok: Chwngno kebeng ya Borok bo chini bwkhak se.

english: Do not stop him; for no one who does a deed of power in my name will be able soon afterward to speak evil of me.
kokborok: Bono ta mwthak di. Ani mung bai ha-o nuk ya samung kotor kotor khlainairok ano daktino hamya sa glak.

english: Salt is good; but if the salt has lost its saltiness, how can you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.
kokborok: Sóm belai kaham. Phiya abo pwrap ya wngwi tháng khe, nwng abono tei kwprap khlaiwi man phi glak. Hakhe nini bisingni a sóm kahamno ta swkwma di. Tei kwchang kwchang khe tong lai di.

english: Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?
kokborok: Borok khoroksa bini hikno kagwi rwmani abo sói da?

english: Let the little children come to me; do not stop them; for it is to such as these that the kingdom of God belongs.
kokborok: Chwrai bwsarokno ani thani rohor di. Bórokno ta kasu di, tamoni hwnma le omo tẃi chwrai bwsa hai bororokni bagwi’-no Kaitorni ha.

english: You shall not murder; You shall not commit adultery; You shall not steal; You shall not bear false witness; You shall not defraud; Honor your father and mother.
kokborok: Borok ta buthar di, buitali-buitala ta wng di, ta khok di, tatal ta sa di, ta phemlok di, nwma nwphano bórom khlai di….
